title: How odd-toed ungulate diversity changed
titleZh: 奇蹄类多样性如何变化
dek: Across 56 million years, fossil records show changing perissodactyl diversity and only a few living branches.

steps.title: First sampled fossils near the PETM
steps.titleZh: 最早的取样化石见于 PETM 前后
steps.text: The earliest sampled perissodactyl fossils occur during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM) on northern landmasses. They do not reveal the exact place or time when the group originated.
steps.textZh: 目前取样到的最早奇蹄类化石出现在北方大陆的古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）期间。这些化石不能揭示该类群确切的起源地点或时间。
steps.annotation: First appearances are fossil observations, not exact origination dates.

steps.title: Different browsing records in the Eocene
steps.titleZh: 始新世的不同食叶记录
steps.text: Eocene brontotheres diversified in North America and Asia. A separate western European sample of Palaeotherium medium supports leaf browsing; it does not establish the diet of every lineage.
steps.textZh: 始新世雷兽科在北美和亚洲多样化。另一项来自西欧的 Palaeotherium medium 样本支持食叶解释；它不能确定每个支系的食性。

steps.title: Cooling, turnover and a gap in the record
steps.titleZh: 气候变冷、动物群更替与记录间断
steps.text: Marine records resolve stepwise ice growth. The Hampshire mammal sequence distinguishes faunal turnover, a gap in the record and later appearances of immigrant taxa. Together, these records do not prove a single cause for changing perissodactyl diversity.
steps.textZh: 海洋记录显示冰量逐步增长；汉普郡哺乳动物序列则区分动物群更替、记录间断和后来移入类群的出现。合在一起，这些记录仍不能证明奇蹄类多样性变化只有一个原因。

steps.title: Living branches and extinct diversity
steps.titleZh: 现生支系与已灭绝的多样性
steps.text: Living horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses represent only a small part of the diversity known from perissodactyl fossils. Coelodonta species also show that extinct rhinoceros ecology was not uniform.
steps.textZh: 现生马、貘和犀牛只代表化石记录中曾有奇蹄类多样性的一小部分。Coelodonta 不同种的资料也显示，已灭绝犀牛的生态并不一致。

dekZh: 在 5600 万年间，化石记录显示奇蹄目多样性不断变化，现存支系仅余少数。

title: Changing of the herbivore guild
titleZh: 大型有蹄动物生态位换班
dek: Follow three moments in changing herbivore communities, keeping regional succession and diet separate from evolutionary ancestry.

steps.title: Brontotheres diversify through the Eocene
steps.titleZh: 雷兽类在始新世扩展
steps.text: Eocene brontotheres ranged from small early forms to rhinoceros-sized species in North America and Asia. This was an extinct herbivore radiation, not a modern animal community recreated in the past.
steps.textZh: 始新世的雷兽类从早期较小的种类发展到犀牛体型的成员，分布于北美和亚洲。这是一场已经灭绝的食草动物辐射，不是把现代动物群投射回过去。

steps.title: Ice growth and mammal turnover near the boundary
steps.titleZh: 冰量增长与哺乳动物更替
steps.text: Near the Eocene–Oligocene boundary, steps in marine ice growth can be aligned with the regional Hampshire mammal sequence. But faunal turnover, gaps in the rock record, and immigration are separate observations; their timing alone does not make them one event.
steps.textZh: 在始新世—渐新世界线附近，海洋记录中的冰量增长阶段可与区域性的 Hampshire 哺乳动物序列对照。但动物群更替、岩层记录间断和外来迁入是不同观察；时间上相邻并不证明它们是同一事件。

steps.title: Miocene feeding niches overlap
steps.titleZh: 中新世食性生态位并存
steps.text: In the Miocene, Anchitherium, hipparionins, and Teleoceras occupied different dietary niches. Evidence varies among lineages and localities, and the change in herbivore guilds unfolded over time rather than in a single replacement.
steps.textZh: 中新世的 Anchitherium、Hipparionini 和 Teleoceras 占据不同的食性生态位。证据随支系和地点而异，食草动物功能群的变化是一个延续过程，并非一次性替换。

dekZh: 跟随草食动物群落变化的三个时刻，同时区分区域演替、食性与演化祖先关系。

title: Metamynodon’s repeated return to the water’s edge
titleZh: Metamynodon 与 Teleoceras 的水边生活假说
dek: Body shape and sedimentary context can support a semi-aquatic hypothesis, but neither directly records behavior or proves a shared ancestry.
dekZh: 身体形态与沉积环境可以支持半水生假说，但都没有直接记录行为，也不能证明不同动物之间共享祖先。

steps.title: Metamynodon: a hippo-like rhinocerotoid
steps.text: Metamynodon planifrons combines high-set eye sockets, reduced thoracic spines and limb-lever proportions unlike those of more terrestrial amynodontids. These anatomical differences motivate a semi-aquatic comparison; they do not show how often the animal entered the water.
steps.titleZh: Metamynodon：骨骼差异提示了什么？
steps.textZh: Metamynodon planifrons 具有位置较高的眼眶、缩短的胸椎棘突，以及不同于较陆生阿米诺齿兽类（amynodontids）的肢体杠杆比例。这些解剖差异促使研究者与半水生动物作比较，却不能说明它多常进入水中。

steps.title: Sandstone adds a setting, not an observed habit
steps.text: Metamynodon fossils occur with Orellan channel sandstones, adding a river-channel context to the anatomical evidence. Deposits and body form together support a hypothesis, while neither captures the animal behaving in its habitat.
steps.titleZh: 河道砂岩补充沉积背景
steps.textZh: Metamynodon 化石与奥雷兰期河道砂岩共同出现，为解剖材料补上河道环境背景。地层与体形合在一起支持一种假说，但两者都没有记录动物在栖地中的实际行为。

steps.title: Similarity does not establish ancestry
steps.text: Semi-aquatic interpretations have also been proposed for Teleoceras, but isotope evidence differs between Florida and Ashfall. That variation cautions against assigning one uniform ecology to Teleoceras; resemblance between it and Metamynodon does not establish direct ancestry.
steps.titleZh: 生态相似不等于亲缘关系
steps.textZh: 研究者也曾提出 Teleoceras 可能半水生，但佛罗里达与 Ashfall 的同位素证据并不相同。这种差异提醒我们，不应把单一生态解释推广到所有 Teleoceras；它与 Metamynodon 的相似也不能证明两者存在直接祖先关系。

title: Horses from forest browsers to open-country runners
titleZh: 马科从林地食叶者到开阔地奔跑者
dek: Horse evolution is a branching history: changes in teeth and toes appeared in different lineages and did not converge on one inevitable runner.
dekZh: 马科演化是一段分支历史：牙齿与趾数的变化发生在不同支系中，并未汇成通往单一奔跑者的必然直线。

steps.title: Small forest equids
steps.titleZh: 小型早期马科
steps.text: Between about 56 and 40 Ma, early equid branches included small, multi-toed animals with low-crowned teeth. They establish the starting diversity of the story; later horses did not simply inherit one straight path toward a single toe.
steps.textZh: 约 5600 万至 4000 万年前，早期马科支系包括体型较小、多趾、牙冠较低的动物。它们呈现了这段历史的早期多样性；后来的马类并非沿着一条直线走向单趾形态。

steps.title: Browsing persists
steps.titleZh: 林地取食并未消失
steps.text: At Sandelzhausen, the tridactyl Anchitherium aurelianense retained low-crowned teeth. Its wear evidence indicates browse-dominated mixed feeding, showing that three-toed horses could persist as browsers rather than fitting a simple forest-versus-grassland split.
steps.textZh: 在 Sandelzhausen，三趾的 Anchitherium aurelianense 仍有低冠牙齿。牙齿磨耗证据显示它以取食树叶为主，同时摄入其他食物，说明三趾马科可以继续以浏览取食为主，不能简单分成“森林型”与“草原型”两类。

steps.title: Open habitats diversify the experiment
steps.titleZh: 开阔环境中的多样化
steps.text: From roughly 13 to 3 Ma, Old World hipparionins stayed tridactyl while lineages diversified in feeding ecology. The evidence ranges from browse-dominated and mixed diets to grazing, so open habitats did not produce one uniform horse form or diet.
steps.textZh: 约 1300 万至 300 万年前，旧大陆的三趾马族仍保留三趾，同时不同支系发展出多样的食性。证据从以浏览为主的混合取食延伸到放牧；开阔环境并未造就一种统一的马形或饮食。

title: Five mass extinctions: reading change in the fossil record
titleZh: 五次大灭绝：如何阅读化石记录中的变化
dek: Follow changes in marine and terrestrial fossils alongside climate and impact evidence, while keeping each event’s timing and scope in view.
dekZh: 沿着海洋与陆地化石的变化，结合气候和撞击证据阅读这些事件；每一段仍需放回各自的年代与研究范围中理解。

steps.title: End-Ordovician: ice, sea level and marine loss
steps.text: Glaciation and falling sea level coincide with a major loss of marine diversity near the end of the Ordovician. Their timing makes them part of the explanation under study, but the fossil record alone does not reduce the event to one cause.
steps.titleZh: 奥陶纪末：冰期、海平面与海洋生物减少
steps.textZh: 奥陶纪末，冰川作用和海平面下降与海洋多样性大幅减少在时间上相合。这种时间关系使它们成为研究中的解释因素，但化石记录本身不能把事件归结为单一原因。

steps.title: Late Devonian: several crises over time
steps.text: Reef systems and other marine communities were affected by multiple crises across an extended interval. The record describes a sequence of losses, rather than one brief event at a single boundary.
steps.titleZh: 泥盆纪晚期：一段时期内的多次危机
steps.textZh: 礁体系统和其他海洋群落在较长时间内经历了多次危机。记录呈现的是一段时期内的多轮损失，而不是发生在某一条界线上的一次短暂事件。

steps.title: End-Permian: the deepest known restructuring
steps.text: The end-Permian crisis produced the deepest known restructuring of Phanerozoic life. Its scale is visible across the sampled fossil record, while the pattern among groups and environments remains part of the evidence to compare.
steps.titleZh: 二叠纪末：显生宙生命最深刻的重组
steps.textZh: 二叠纪末危机造成了已知显生宙生命最深刻的重组。其规模可从已采样的化石记录中看出；不同类群和环境中的变化模式仍需继续比较证据。

steps.title: End-Triassic: turnover before Jurassic dominance
steps.text: Marine and terrestrial ecosystems both show turnover across the end-Triassic interval. The change precedes the Jurassic dominance of dinosaurs; that sequence in time does not by itself describe every local cause or ecological response.
steps.titleZh: 三叠纪末：侏罗纪恐龙优势之前的更替
steps.textZh: 三叠纪末的海洋和陆地生态系统都显示出更替。这一变化先于侏罗纪恐龙占据优势；时间上的先后本身不能说明每个地区的原因或生态响应。

steps.title: K–Pg: an impact boundary and selective survival
steps.text: The Chicxulub impact marks an abrupt global boundary at the Cretaceous–Paleogene transition. Survival was selective: extinction and persistence varied among lineages rather than affecting all organisms in the same way.
steps.titleZh: K–Pg：撞击界线与选择性存活
steps.textZh: 希克苏鲁伯撞击标记了白垩纪–古近纪（K–Pg）转折处突然而全球性的界线。存活具有选择性：不同谱系的灭绝和延续并不相同，并非所有生物都受到同样影响。

title: Seven evidence boundaries from fins to limbs
titleZh: 从鳍到肢演化中的七道证据边界
dek: Read tracks, whole bodies, internal fin bones, digits and joint models as different kinds of evidence. The named fossils do not form a direct chain of ancestors.

steps.title: A mosaic of changes, not a march
steps.text: One synthesis separates the appearance of digits, changes in movement and the ability to live fully on land. Its broad time window organizes evidence from different places and animals; it is not one event or an ancestor-to-descendant sequence.
steps.annotation: A transitional character combination can illuminate evolution without making its bearer the direct ancestor of another named fossil.
steps.titleZh: 变化镶嵌，而非单向阶梯
steps.textZh: 一项综述把趾的出现、运动方式的变化和完全陆生能力分开讨论。其宽泛时间窗汇集不同地点和动物的证据；它不是单一事件，也不是祖先到后代的序列。

steps.title: Tracks without a named body
steps.text: Eifelian surfaces at Zachełmie preserve quadrupedal tracks and impressions of digits. Tracks constrain how an animal moved, but they cannot identify a named body-fossil species, provide its full anatomy or prove that it was an ancestor of later tetrapods.
steps.annotation: The displayed interval is the current Eifelian stage window, not an error bar on one footprint.
steps.titleZh: 只有足迹，没有具名身体
steps.textZh: 扎赫尔米的埃菲尔阶地表保存了四足行迹和趾印。足迹能约束动物如何移动，却不能鉴定某个具名身体化石物种、提供完整解剖，也不能证明造迹者是后来的四足动物祖先。

steps.title: One animal with fish and tetrapod-like features
steps.text: Tiktaalik combines scales, fin rays and fish-like jaws with a mobile neck, a modified ear region and strong ribs. Its anatomy and setting make shallow-water use a testable hypothesis; they do not record it walking on land.
steps.annotation: Intermediate morphology is not evidence that the specimen lies on a direct ancestral line.
steps.titleZh: 同一动物兼有鱼类和四足动物样特征
steps.textZh: Tiktaalik 同时保留鳞片、鳍条和鱼类样颌骨，也有灵活的颈部、改造的耳区和强壮肋骨。其解剖与沉积背景使浅水活动成为可检验的假说，但没有记录它在陆地行走。

steps.title: A wrist-like joint inside a fin
steps.text: Tiktaalik’s pectoral fin has a robust internal skeleton and wrist-like joints that could transmit load. Fin rays remain, however, and the fossil preserves neither free digits nor tracks made by this animal.
steps.annotation: Joint geometry supports a functional inference; it does not replay a witnessed gait.
steps.titleZh: 鳍内的腕状关节
steps.textZh: Tiktaalik 的胸鳍有坚固的内部骨骼和腕状关节，可能传递负荷。但鳍条仍然存在；化石既没有保存游离的趾，也没有保存该个体留下的足迹。

steps.title: Digit-like bones beneath fin rays
steps.text: CT images of MHNM 06-2067 reveal branched wrist bones and rows at the end of the fin that researchers interpret as digits or possible digits. Fin rays, called lepidotrichia, are still present, so the appendage remains a fin.
steps.annotation: Digit homology and sister-group placement are analyses, not labels fixed forever by the specimen.
steps.titleZh: 鳍条之下的趾状骨骼
steps.textZh: MHNM 06-2067 的 CT 图像显示分支状腕骨和鳍远端的骨列，研究者将其解释为趾或可能的趾。鳍条 lepidotrichia 仍然保留，所以这个附肢仍是鳍。

steps.title: Eight digits do not prove walking on land
steps.text: The described Acanthostega forelimb has eight digits; Ichthyostega has seven and Tulerpeton six. These fossils show that early tetrapods did not begin with a fixed five-digit pattern. Digit number alone does not tell us whether an animal walked on land.
steps.annotation: Digit count, appendage function and habitat are separate claims.
steps.titleZh: 八个趾不能证明陆地行走
steps.textZh: 已描述的 Acanthostega 前肢有八趾；Ichthyostega 有七趾，Tulerpeton 有六趾。这些化石显示早期四足动物并非从固定的五趾模式开始。仅凭趾数无法判断动物是否在陆地行走。

steps.title: A joint model tests one animal’s movement
steps.text: A three-dimensional reconstruction of Ichthyostega’s joints found that they lacked rotations needed for a typical side-to-side walking sequence. The model suggests restricted mobility or a specialization of this animal, not a universal gait for early tetrapods.
steps.annotation: Feasible joint motion is a model constraint, not direct observation of behaviour and not a template for every Devonian tetrapod.
steps.titleZh: 关节模型检验一只动物的运动
steps.textZh: Ichthyostega 关节的三维复原发现，它缺少典型左右交替行走所需的关节旋转。模型提示该动物活动受限或具有自身特化，不能据此概括所有早期四足动物的步态。

dekZh: 将足迹、完整身体、鳍内骨骼、趾和关节模型视为不同类型的证据。具名化石并不构成直接祖先链。

title: Mammals did not begin at K–Pg
titleZh: 哺乳动物并非在恐龙灭绝后才出现
dek: The K–Pg boundary changed opportunities for surviving mammals. Their evolutionary history had begun far earlier.
overviewZh: 白垩纪—古近纪界线改变了幸存哺乳动物面对的生态机会，但哺乳动物的演化历史早已开始。

steps.title: A much older branch
steps.titleZh: 远早于冠群哺乳类的支系
steps.text: The synapsid lineage begins hundreds of millions of years before crown mammals.
steps.textZh: 合弓类谱系的历史比冠群哺乳类早数亿年。K–Pg 界线并非哺乳动物起源的时间。

steps.title: Mesozoic mammal diversity
steps.titleZh: 中生代哺乳动物并不单一
steps.text: Small body size does not mean ecological uniformity: Mesozoic mammals include climbers, diggers, swimmers and gliders.
steps.textZh: 体型小并不表示生态方式单一：中生代哺乳动物中包括攀爬、掘洞、游泳和滑翔的类型。

steps.title: Radiation after survival
steps.titleZh: 幸存后的辐射
steps.text: After 66 Ma, surviving mammal lineages expanded in body size and ecological roles.
steps.textZh: 66 Ma 之后，幸存的哺乳动物支系在体型和生态角色方面扩展。

dekZh: K–Pg 界线改变了幸存哺乳动物面临的演化机遇；它们的演化史早在此之前就已开始。

title: From synapsids to mammals
titleZh: 从合弓纲到现代哺乳类
dek: Trace changes in the jaw, middle ear, teeth and posture across a long transition in synapsid history.
dekZh: 沿着颌、耳、牙齿与姿态的变化，追踪合弓类漫长演化史中的一段转变。

steps.title: The early amniote branches
steps.titleZh: 羊膜动物的早期分支
steps.text: Early in amniote history, synapsids and sauropsids diverged into separate lineages. This marks a branch in the tree, not a named fossil ancestor.
steps.textZh: 羊膜动物演化早期，合弓类与蜥形类分化为不同支系。这里展示的是演化树上的分支，并非一件具名化石祖先。

steps.title: Many therapsid forms
steps.titleZh: 多样的兽孔类
steps.text: Across Permian and Triassic synapsids, posture, feeding and skull architecture changed. These broad patterns do not make each form a rung in a single ladder.
steps.textZh: 二叠纪至三叠纪的合弓类在姿态、取食方式和头骨结构上呈现变化。这些广泛的变化并不意味着每种动物都排成一条单线阶梯。

steps.title: The jaw joint and middle ear
steps.titleZh: 颌关节与中耳
steps.text: Small-bodied forms document a sequence in which the mammalian jaw joint and detached middle-ear bones emerge. No single fossil in this overview captures the whole transition.
steps.textZh: 一系列小型类群记录了哺乳动物式颌关节和脱离下颌的中耳骨逐步出现的过程。这里概述的是一段序列，并非某一件化石呈现了完整转变。

title: How the early land-plant record takes shape
titleZh: 早期陆生植物化石记录如何逐步成形
dek: Evidence runs from a modelled crown divergence through dispersed spores, plant fragments and anatomically preserved Devonian fossils. These records answer different questions and do not fix one origin date.

steps.title: A modelled crown interval
steps.titleZh: 模型推算的冠群区间
steps.text: A fossil-calibrated relaxed molecular clock places the crown group of land plants (Embryophyta) in a broad middle Cambrian–Early Ordovician interval. This is a model result, not a fossil occurrence from that interval.
steps.textZh: 一项以化石校准的松弛分子钟研究，将陆生植物冠群（胚胎植物）置于寒武纪中期至早奥陶世的宽泛区间。这是模型结果，不是该时段发现的化石。
steps.annotation: The Plantae node is navigation context; the claim concerns crown Embryophyta.

steps.title: Dispersed spores on emerged land
steps.titleZh: 陆地上的散布孢子
steps.text: An Argentine Dapingian assemblage contains five cryptospore genera—dispersed spores rather than whole plants. The propagules do not reveal a complete parent plant or establish crown-bryophyte identity.
steps.textZh: 阿根廷达平期的一个组合含五个隐孢子属，也就是散布的孢子，而不是完整植物。仅凭这些传播体无法还原母体植物，也不能确定它们属于苔藓植物冠群。
steps.annotation: The source-reported numerical ages are retained; they are not silently replaced by the current ICS Dapingian boundaries.

steps.title: Spores linked to plant fragments
steps.titleZh: 与植物碎片相连的孢子
steps.text: Late Ordovician fragments from Oman preserve dense spore masses and probable tissue around a sporangium, the spore-producing case. This strengthens the land-plant interpretation, while affinity to the liverwort crown group remains tentative.
steps.textZh: 阿曼晚奥陶世的植物碎片保存了密集孢子团，以及可能围绕孢子囊（产孢结构）的组织。这加强了陆生植物的解释，但它们与现生苔类冠群的亲缘关系仍不确定。
steps.annotation: The broad window translates a legacy Caradoc assignment for display; it is not a point date.

steps.title: A three-axis rooting system
steps.titleZh: 三轴构成的扎根系统
steps.text: Three-dimensional reconstruction shows Asteroxylon with leafy shoots, axes bearing roots and separate rooting axes. This is an extinct developmental arrangement.
steps.textZh: 三维重建显示，Asteroxylon 同时具有带叶枝条、长有根的轴，以及其他扎根轴。这是一个已经灭绝的发育结构。
steps.annotation: A species-level exemplar cannot supply morphology for every lycophyte lineage.

steps.title: A liverwort body-fossil record
steps.titleZh: 一条苔类身体化石记录
steps.text: Givetian Metzgeriothallus preserves flat gametophytes and an associated spore-producing capsule. The fossil adds body-plan evidence, but one occurrence does not date the origin of the whole plant group.
steps.textZh: 泥盆纪 Givetian 阶的 Metzgeriothallus 保存了扁平配子体（产生生殖细胞的世代）和相关的产孢蒴。这补充了身体结构证据，但单个化石记录不能确定整个植物类群的起源。
steps.annotation: Occurrence, morphology and crown divergence remain separate evidence objects.

dekZh: 证据从模型推算的冠群分化时间，延伸到散布的孢子、植物碎片及解剖结构保存完好的泥盆纪化石。这些记录回答不同问题，无法确定唯一的起源年代。

title: Six boundaries in gymnosperm deep time
titleZh: 裸子植物深时研究的六条证据边界
dek: A Ginkgo-like wood, several fossil-calibrated and biogeographic models, and a tree of living gymnosperms illuminate different boundaries. Read them as separate windows, not as one timeline for the origin of every living lineage.
dekZh: 一段似银杏木材、若干化石校准和生物地理模型，以及现生裸子植物系统树，各自照亮不同问题。它们应作为彼此独立的证据窗口阅读，而不是拼成一条适用于所有现生支系的起源时间线。

steps.title: One Jurassic wood specimen
steps.titleZh: 一块侏罗纪木化石
steps.text: The Jurassic specimen PB22285 preserves a combination of Ginkgo-like wood characters in strata dated 165–153 Ma. Wood can identify anatomical resemblance, but an isolated organ cannot reveal the whole plant or establish the first appearance of Ginkgophyta.
steps.textZh: 侏罗纪标本 PB22285 保存了一组类似银杏类的木材特征，所在地层年代为 1.65 亿至 1.53 亿年前。木材可显示解剖相似性，但孤立器官不能还原整株植物，也不能确定银杏门首次出现的时间。
steps.annotation: A specimen occurrence, a whole-plant association and a clade first appearance are three different claims.

steps.title: A crown age moves with calibration
steps.titleZh: 校准会移动冠群年龄
steps.text: A plastome-clock analysis using fossil and tectonic constraints places the crown of living Cycadaceae earlier than a Miocene-only account would suggest. Alternative calibration schemes move the estimate substantially, so the crown age belongs to the model and its assumptions.
steps.textZh: 一项叶绿体基因组时钟分析结合化石与构造约束，把现生苏铁科冠群估得早于“中新世才出现”的单一叙事。替代校准方案会大幅改变估计，因此冠群年龄属于具体模型及其假设。
steps.annotation: The event dates a modelled crown of living Cycadaceae, not the fossil first appearance of all cycads.

steps.title: Fossils change the map
steps.titleZh: 化石让分布地图变大
steps.text: When fossil leaves are added to a species-level cycad model, inferred past ranges extend farther in latitude and the number of inferred local extirpations rises. Living distributions alone omit those former populations and range shifts.
steps.textZh: 把化石叶片纳入苏铁物种层级模型后，重建的过去分布向更高纬度延伸，推断的局部灭绝次数也增加。只看现生分布会漏掉这些历史种群和范围变化。
steps.annotation: The wide interval summarizes a modelled transition; it is not one precisely dated global extinction pulse.

steps.title: A famous young-radiation model
steps.titleZh: 影响深远的年轻辐射模型
steps.text: A 2011 analysis proposed that most sampled living cycad species were younger than about 12 Ma. That result remains an important hypothesis about sampled living species, but later fossil-integrated analyses prevent it from serving as the age of the entire order Cycadales.
steps.textZh: 2011 年的一项分析提出，大多数被采样的现生苏铁种不早于约 1200 万年前。这个结论仍是关于现生取样种类的重要假说；后来的化石整合研究则表明，它不能代表整个苏铁目（Cycadales）的年龄。
steps.annotation: Living-species radiation, crown age, stem history and fossil first appearance must stay separate.

steps.title: A relative hemispheric pattern
steps.titleZh: 南北半球的相对差异
steps.text: In one time tree of living conifers, sampled Southern Hemisphere lineages have older median nodes than sampled Northern Hemisphere lineages. Those medians describe that tree’s pattern; they are not the origin dates or fossil ranges of the families.
steps.textZh: 一棵仅含现生针叶树的时间树中，南半球取样支系的节点年龄中位数高于北半球取样支系。这只是该树呈现的相对模式，不是科的起源日期或化石分布年代。
steps.annotation: The comparison excludes Gnetales and does not validate the atlas's provisional Araucariaceae range.

steps.title: Topology is not a timeline
steps.titleZh: 系统树拓扑不是年代
steps.text: A broad nuclear dataset groups cycads with Ginkgo and recovers a Gnetales–Pinaceae relationship among living gymnosperm families. Conflicting gene trees and the absence of extinct lineages from a living-only sample limit how far that topology can be extended through deep time.
steps.textZh: 一套广泛的核基因数据将苏铁与银杏归为近缘，并在现生裸子植物科中恢复买麻藤科与松科的关系。基因树冲突以及缺少灭绝支系，限制了把这张现生系统树外推到深时的范围。
steps.annotation: This hypothesis does not replace the global navigation tree or supply chronological branch lengths.

title: Flowering-plant history through seven evidence windows
titleZh: 从七种证据窗口看被子植物历史
dek: Move from clock calibrations to whole-plant fossils, then to regional grass proxies; each record answers a different question.
dekZh: 从分子钟校准到整株植物化石，再到区域性草地替代指标；每类记录回答不同问题。

steps.title: A clock estimate depends on its calibrations
steps.text: A 2026 analysis combines molecular data with 25,685 fossil occurrences to estimate when the crown group of living flowering plants—their last common ancestor and all its descendants—began. Its preferred hard-bound treatment gives a narrow Late Jurassic result, while other calibration choices yield much older estimates. These are clock outputs, not a fossil flower dated to the group’s origin.
steps.titleZh: 时钟估计取决于校准方法
steps.textZh: 2026 年的一项分析把分子数据与 25,685 条化石出现记录结合起来，估计现生被子植物冠群——现生成员的最近共同祖先及其所有后代——何时开始。研究者偏好的硬界限方案给出较窄的晚侏罗世结果，其他校准选择则产生更古老的估计。这些是分子钟的输出，并非一朵直接为该类群起源定年的花。
steps.annotation: The atlas displays the preferred hard-bound result while exposing the much older alternatives beside it.

steps.title: A separate model dates major crown branches
steps.text: A separately calibrated time tree places several major branches within the living flowering-plant group near 135–130 Ma. These are modelled divergence estimates; they do not validate older atlas ranges or record the first fossil appearance of each branch.
steps.titleZh: 另一模型估计主要冠群分支的年代
steps.textZh: 另一棵经过元校准的时间树把被子植物现生类群中的若干主要分支置于约 1.35 亿至 1.30 亿年前。这些是模型估计的分化年代，不能验证图谱中的旧延限，也不是各分支最早的化石出现记录。
steps.annotation: The navigation tree is an educational subset: monocots and eudicots do not exhaust Angiospermae, and Magnoliopsida is not an exact eudicot catalogue root.

steps.title: What a thousand Montsechia fossils preserve
steps.text: More than one thousand Montsechia specimens preserve leafy axes and closed, single-seeded fruits. Their depositional setting supports interpreting this extinct plant as submerged in freshwater. That local habit does not show that the ancestor of flowering plants was aquatic.
steps.titleZh: 一千多件 Montsechia 化石保存了什么
steps.textZh: 一千多件 Montsechia 标本保存了有叶茎轴和闭合的单籽果实。沉积环境支持将这种已灭绝植物解释为生长在淡水中的沉水植物；但这一局地生活方式不能说明被子植物祖先也生活在水中。
steps.annotation: A fossil habit, a phylogenetic placement and an ancestral ecological state are different claims.

steps.title: Leefructus links leaves to reproduction
steps.text: Leefructus preserves diagnostic leaves together with reproductive organs in a Yixian bed dated to 125.8–122.6 Ma. That association supports an early fossil record for eudicots, a major flowering-plant branch, while its proposed Ranunculaceae affinity remains provisional.
steps.titleZh: Leefructus 把叶片与繁殖器官联系起来
steps.textZh: Leefructus 在年代为 1.258 亿至 1.226 亿年前的义县组层位中，同时保存了可诊断的叶片与繁殖器官。这一组合支持早期真双子叶植物化石记录；真双子叶植物是被子植物的一个主要分支，但它与毛茛科的亲缘关系仍属暂定。
steps.annotation: One locality cannot define the global origin, first appearance or diversity of eudicots.

steps.title: Cratolirion preserves the whole plant together
steps.text: At about 115 Ma, Cratolirion preserves roots, leaves, internal anatomy and reproductive organs in one whole-plant record. A monocot is a flowering plant lineage characterized by one seed leaf; a crown-monocot placement does not make this fossil a modern lily or the first member of that lineage.
steps.titleZh: Cratolirion 同时保存了整株植物
steps.textZh: 约 1.15 亿年前的 Cratolirion 化石把根、叶、内部解剖和繁殖器官保存在同一株植物中。单子叶植物是具有一枚子叶特征的被子植物谱系；把化石放入单子叶植物冠群，并不意味着它就是现生百合或该谱系的第一成员。
steps.annotation: Whole-plant preservation strengthens character association, not claims beyond the analysed specimen and placement.

steps.title: Grass phytoliths show a regional shift
steps.text: Fourteen Great Plains palaeosol assemblages—ancient soils—show an 8–5.5 Ma rise in phytoliths attributed to grasses that may use the C4 photosynthetic pathway. Phytoliths are microscopic silica bodies formed in plant tissues. The reported 50–60% share is within the grass sample, not a measure of all vegetation cover.
steps.titleZh: 草类植硅体显示一个区域变化
steps.textZh: 大平原的 14 组古土壤记录显示，约 800 万至 550 万年前，可能来自采用 C4 光合途径草类的植硅体增多。植硅体是植物组织形成的微小二氧化硅体。报告中的 50%–60% 指草类样本内部的比例，并非所有植被覆盖率。
steps.annotation: Regional assemblages and diagnostic limits prevent a synchronous global C4-grassland claim.

steps.title: Tooth enamel tracks C4 biomass, not grassland cover
steps.text: Carbon isotopes in tooth enamel preserve a dietary signal that tracks widespread but regionally asynchronous C4 biomass expansion around 8–6 Ma. The proxy does not identify the exact C4 plant lineages and does not directly measure how much open grassland covered the landscape.
steps.titleZh: 牙釉质记录 C4 生物量，而非草原覆盖
steps.textZh: 牙釉质中的碳同位素保存了饮食信号，显示约 800 万至 600 万年前 C4 植物生物量广泛扩张，但各地时间并不同步。这种替代指标不能确定具体的 C4 植物谱系，也不能直接测量开阔草原的地表覆盖率。
steps.annotation: Dietary isotope proxy, plant identity, vegetation cover and faunal adaptation must remain separate.

title: Three early-fish fossils, three different boundaries
titleZh: 三组早期鱼类化石，三条不同边界
dek: Three early vertebrate fossils preserve different evidence and sit on different branches. Their local ages do not define global origins for the living groups.
overviewZh: 三组早期脊椎动物化石保存不同证据，位于不同演化支系上。它们在局部地层中的年代不能定义现生类群的全球起源时间。

steps.title: An articulated jawed stem vertebrate
steps.titleZh: 关节相连的有颌干群脊椎动物
steps.text: IVPP V300001 and twenty referred Xiushanosteus specimens preserve a roughly 436 Ma placoderm-grade body and a mosaic skull roof. Abundance in one Lagerstätte does not make the animal a direct ancestor or global first appearance.
steps.textZh: IVPP V300001 与 20 件归入的 Xiushanosteus 标本，呈现约 4.36 亿年前的盾皮鱼级身体构型和特征镶嵌的头顶骨。一个化石库中的丰富标本不表示该动物是直系祖先或全球最早记录。
steps.annotation: Articulation strengthens anatomical association; it does not convert a stem-grade taxon into a crown ancestor.

steps.title: A lamprey-like oral apparatus
steps.titleZh: 七鳃鳗样的口部结构
steps.text: Holotype AM5750 preserves a large oral disc, fourteen circumoral teeth and a branchial basket at roughly 360 Ma. These structures diagnose total-group lamprey anatomy, not parasitism, migration or an ammocoete lifecycle.
steps.textZh: 正模 AM5750 保存了大型口盘、14 枚环口齿和鳃篮，年代约 3.6 亿年前。这些结构支持总群七鳃鳗形态判断，却不能证明寄生、迁徙或幼体期的生活史。
steps.annotation: A body fossil can preserve adult-like structures while leaving lifecycle and crown-node timing unresolved.

steps.title: A stem hagfish is not crown Myxini
steps.titleZh: 干群盲鳗不等于冠群盲鳗
steps.text: FMNH PF15373 and PF8472 preserve a roughly 310–307 Ma cyclostome–hagfish mosaic, but different preservation and equivocal structures require a stem or putative total-group reading. The separate Myxini navigation node therefore does not inherit this age.
steps.textZh: FMNH PF15373 和 PF8472 保存了约 3.10 亿至 3.07 亿年前的圆口类—盲鳗特征组合；保存差异和难以判定的结构要求采用干群或候选总群解释。因此，盲鳗导航节点不继承这段年代。
steps.annotation: Total-group occurrence and crown-group range are separate evidence objects.

dekZh: 三件早期脊椎动物化石保存着不同证据，且位于不同支系。它们在当地的年代不能界定现生类群的全球起源时间。

title: Four fossil records on the chondrichthyan stem
titleZh: 软骨鱼干群上的四组化石证据
dek: Follow the evidence from isolated tooth sets to articulated skeletons. Each specimen shows a different body part or character combination; none by itself settles crown placement or a global first appearance.

steps.title: Tooth sets without a known body
steps.text: About 23 Qianodus tooth whorls—repeating sets of teeth—date to roughly 439 Ma and directly document jawed-vertebrate dentition. No associated jaw or body is known. Scales and spines found nearby cannot be assigned to Qianodus by proximity alone.
steps.annotation: Earliest direct dental evidence in the study is narrower than the origin of jaws or crown Chondrichthyes.
steps.titleZh: 已知牙齿，未知身体
steps.textZh: 约 23 组 Qianodus 轮生牙列，即成组重复排列的牙齿，年代约为 439 Ma，直接记录了有颌脊椎动物的齿列。目前没有已知的关联颌骨或身体材料。附近发现的鳞片和棘不能仅因位置接近就归入 Qianodus。

steps.title: A shoulder assembled from separate pieces
steps.text: Fanjingshania’s disarticulated, skin-derived skeletal elements are also roughly 439 Ma. They preserve a spine-and-plate complex that grew from several centres and records cyclical tissue resorption. Because the pieces are not articulated, they do not reveal a complete body or associated teeth.
steps.annotation: Co-occurrence of Qianodus and Fanjingshania is not evidence that they are the same animal.
steps.titleZh: 肩带由分散材料拼成
steps.textZh: Fanjingshania 分散保存的皮肤衍生骨骼元素也约为 439 Ma。它们保存了由多个中心生长的棘—板复合结构，以及周期性的组织吸收。由于这些碎片并未关节相连，无法显示完整身体或伴生牙齿。

steps.title: Armour in an articulated body
steps.text: At about 436 Ma, the Shenacanthus holotype combines minute scales and a chondrichthyan-like rear gill region with large thoracic armour plates. It is a single toothless specimen, and its placement changes with analytical method; the armour does not make it a crown shark.
steps.annotation: A chondrichthyan total-group placement is not a diagnosis of the living shark crown.
steps.titleZh: 关节相连个体中的胸甲
steps.textZh: 约 436 Ma 的 Shenacanthus 正模将细小鳞片、类似软骨鱼的后部鳃区和大型胸甲组合在一起。它是一件没有牙齿的单件标本，其系统位置会随分析方法变化；有胸甲并不能使它成为冠群鲨鱼。

steps.title: A later stem form with a mixed anatomy
steps.text: Around 385 Ma, UMZC 2000.32 preserves jaws, gill arches, cartilage, scales and teeth in an unusual character mix. Compression and a missing tail limit reconstruction; its proposed feeding ecology is inferred rather than directly observed.
steps.annotation: The stable shark-like morphotype was assembled through a more disparate stem history than one specimen can summarize.
steps.titleZh: 解剖特征混合的较晚干群形态
steps.textZh: 约 385 Ma 的 UMZC 2000.32 保存了颌骨、鳃弓、软骨、鳞片和牙齿，呈现少见的性状组合。挤压变形和尾部缺失限制身体复原；对其摄食生态的解释来自推断，而非直接观察。

dekZh: 从分散牙齿到关节相连的骨架，沿证据追踪不同身体部位和性状组合。每件标本都有自己的范围边界，单件都不能独自确定冠群位置或全球首次出现。

title: Seven evidence boundaries in ray-finned fish history
titleZh: 辐鳍鱼历史的七条证据边界
dek: Seven case studies show why a fossil's occurrence, a modelled event date, a living-species tree and a database's name coverage answer different questions.
dekZh: 七个案例说明，化石出现、模型推算的事件年代、现生类群系统树和数据库中的名称覆盖回答的是不同问题。

steps.title: Cheirolepis anatomy from named specimens
steps.titleZh: 从具名标本观察 Cheirolepis
steps.text: CT scans of named Cheirolepis specimens show an imperforate propterygium, a shaft of the hyomandibular bone and scales with peg-and-socket joints. These features describe the sampled fish; its late Eifelian occurrence is neither the global first ray-finned fish nor a direct ancestor.
steps.textZh: 对具名 Cheirolepis 标本的 CT 扫描显示无孔的胸鳍前骨、舌颌骨骨干，以及具有榫槽式连接的鳞片。这些特征描述的是已研究的标本；其晚艾菲尔期出现并非辐鳍鱼的全球首现，也不代表直系祖先。
steps.annotation: Specimen anatomy, stage assignment and lineage origin are separate claims.

steps.title: Dating a genome duplication with molecules
steps.titleZh: 用分子模型推算基因组复制年代
steps.text: Thirty duplicated-gene pairs place the teleost third-round genome duplication (3R) at 286.18–267.20 Ma in the study's models, before its crown-Teleostei interval. These are inferred time windows, not a fossil first appearance or an instantaneous observation.
steps.textZh: 三十对重复基因在该研究的模型中，将真骨鱼类第三轮全基因组复制（3R）约束在 2.8618–2.6720 亿年前，早于其冠群真骨鱼区间。这些是推算出的时间窗口，不是化石首现或瞬时可观察事件。
steps.annotation: Duplication, rediploidization and later diversification are not one synchronous causal event.

steps.title: A tree placement changes fossil calibrations
steps.titleZh: 化石位置改变校准边界
steps.text: The 2017 analysis places Fukangichthys and other scanilepiforms on the polypterid stem, changing which fossils can calibrate living actinopterygians. This depends on the tree topology and differs from the published 2014 placement.
steps.textZh: 2017 年的分析将 Fukangichthys 与其他裂齿鱼类置于多鳍鱼类干群，因而改变了哪些化石可用于校准现生辐鳍鱼类。这个结果取决于系统树拓扑，也不同于 2014 年发表的位置。
steps.annotation: A minimum calibration is younger than some previous calibrations; it is not the crown's birth time.

steps.title: Several early forms at one Triassic quarry
steps.titleZh: 三叠纪同一采石场的多个早期形态
steps.text: Named Rüdersdorf holotypes and referred specimens preserve several early teleosteomorph body forms at one quarry, near 244 Ma. Their stem placement and single-locality sample establish neither the crown-Teleostei first appearance nor a worldwide radiation.
steps.textZh: 来自 Rüdersdorf 的具名正模和归入标本，在同一采石场记录了约 2.44 亿年前的多个早期真骨形类体型。它们位于干群且来自单一地点，既不能确定冠群真骨鱼的全球首现，也不能证明全球范围的辐射演化。
steps.annotation: The current Anisian display envelope is broader than the source's approximate locality age.

steps.title: Living genomes group gars and bowfin
steps.titleZh: 现生基因组将雀鳝与弓鳍鱼归为一支
steps.text: The spotted-gar genome, bowfin transcriptome and comparative synteny support gars and bowfin together as Holostei, sister to teleosts. These living-species data do not directly date fossils or show that anatomy stayed unchanged.
steps.textZh: 雀鳝基因组、弓鳍鱼转录组和比较共线性分析支持雀鳝与弓鳍鱼组成全骨鱼类，并作为真骨鱼类的姐妹群。这些现生类群数据不能直接测定化石年代，也不能证明解剖结构始终未变。
steps.annotation: A genomic outgroup to teleost duplication is not a deterministic explanation for teleost richness.

steps.title: A tail feature spans the gar–teleost split
steps.titleZh: 尾部特征跨越雀鳝与真骨鱼的分支
steps.text: Developmental series show a hypural–diastema complex in both gar and teleost tails, while bowfin and other comparisons reveal a mosaic pattern. Inheritance followed by losses and latent parallelism remain alternative explanations.
steps.textZh: 发育序列显示雀鳝和真骨鱼的尾部都具有下尾骨—间隙复合结构；弓鳍鱼及其他比较材料则呈现镶嵌模式。该结构可能源自共同继承后多次丢失，也可能涉及潜在平行演化，现有证据保留这两种解释。
steps.annotation: Soft tissues and vasculature make the living complex richer than the component usually visible in fossils.

steps.title: Independent markers support a deep split
steps.titleZh: 多种基因组标记支持深层分支
steps.text: Gene trees and chromosome-adjacency markers support Elopomorpha plus Osteoglossomorpha as sister to Clupeocephala in the sampled living genomes. This is neither a complete species tree nor a direct observation of an ancient chromosome fusion.
steps.textZh: 在被抽样的现生基因组中，基因树和染色体邻接标记支持海鲢形类与骨舌鱼形类组成的一支，是与鲱形类互为姐妹群的另一支。这既不是完整的物种树，也不是对古代染色体融合事件的直接观察。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 35,928 strictly accepted species names below Actinopterygii (usage ID 8VR36); that is naming coverage, not 35,928 mature dossiers, verified morphologies, fossil ranges, media recordss.

title: Five amphibian fossils, five evidence limits
titleZh: 五组两栖类化石，五条证据边界
dek: Five fossils show how anatomy, age, and classification can answer different questions about amphibian history. Stem groups, living crown groups, direct ancestry, and the earliest known global record remain separate claims.
summaryZh: 五组化石展示了解剖、年代与分类证据如何回答两栖类演化史中的不同问题。干群、现生冠群、直接祖先关系与全球最早记录仍是彼此不同的主张。

steps.title: A mosaic outside the living crown
steps.text: The Gerobatrachus holotype combines frog-like and salamander-like features in the original analysis. Its placement supports a stem batrachian, outside the living crown group of frogs and salamanders; it does not make this fossil a direct ancestor of living species.
steps.titleZh: 位于现生冠群之外的形态组合
steps.textZh: Gerobatrachus 正模在原始分析中同时具有类似蛙类和蝾螈的特征。其位置支持它属于冠群 Batrachia 之外的干群 batrachian；这并不意味着它是现生物种的直接祖先。
steps.annotation: A proposed topology and a specimen occurrence are narrower than the origin of living amphibians.

steps.title: CT scans reveal a longer trunk
steps.text: Micro-CT scans of the unique Triadobatrachus holotype reveal caudal vertebrae and a long trunk. The anatomy supports stem Salientia, outside crown Anura, and does not show the specialized jumping seen in living frogs.
steps.titleZh: CT 扫描揭示更长的躯干
steps.textZh: 对唯一的 Triadobatrachus 正模进行微型 CT 扫描后，研究者辨认出尾椎和较长的躯干。解剖证据支持其位于冠群 Anura 之外的干群 Salientia，也没有显示现生蛙类那种特化跳跃能力。
steps.annotation: Historical provenance and current numerical chart boundaries remain visibly separate.

steps.title: Many individuals, separate bones
steps.text: A dated bonebed contains elements from at least 76 Funcusvermis individuals. The sample supports Gymnophionomorpha, while the animal remains outside crown Gymnophiona, the group containing living caecilians.
steps.titleZh: 许多个体，分散骨骼
steps.textZh: 一处有年代依据的骨床包含至少 76 个 Funcusvermis 个体的骨骼。样本支持其属于 Gymnophionomorpha，但它仍在冠群 Gymnophiona 之外；现生蚓螈属于后者。
steps.annotation: A total-group occurrence cannot set the crown-group range.

steps.title: Articulated salamanders below a dated flow
steps.text: Specimens PKUP V0601–V0606 preserve articulated salamandroid skeletons beneath a volcanic flow. Zircon dating of the overlying rock supports an Oxfordian record; neoteny, or retention of juvenile features, is an interpretation rather than a directly observed life history.
steps.titleZh: 火山流以下的相连蝾螈类骨架
steps.textZh: PKUP V0601–V0606 保存了彼此相连的蝾螈类骨架，产于一层有年代测定的火山流之下。上覆岩层中的锆石测年支持牛津期记录；幼态延续（保留幼年特征）是解释，并非直接观察到的生活史。
steps.annotation: Association strengthens anatomy while leaving age and developmental interpretation bounded.

steps.title: A provisional comparison with living caecilians
steps.text: DGM 1462-R supports an Oligocene caecilian compared with living Typhlonectidae. A formal phylogenetic test and an unambiguous family-level shared feature are lacking, so the family assignment remains provisional.
steps.titleZh: 与现生蚓螈的暂定比较
steps.textZh: DGM 1462-R 支持一件渐新世蚓螈标本，并将其与现生 Typhlonectidae 作比较。尚无正式系统发育检验，也没有明确的科级共有特征，因此科级归属仍属暂定。
steps.annotation: The crown display bound is deliberately low-confidence and revision-ready.

dekZh: 五种化石展示了形态、年代和分类如何分别回答两栖动物历史中的不同问题。干群、现生冠群、直接祖先关系和目前已知最早的全球记录，仍是彼此不同的论断。

title: Living amphibian data: genome, experiment and tree
titleZh: 现生两栖动物数据：基因组、实验与系统树
dek: A frog genome, receptor-knockout experiments, and a 7,238-species timetree answer different questions; none is a fossil record of ancestry or complete amphibian coverage.

steps.title: One frog genome, with a defined sample
steps.titleZh: 一份取样范围明确的蛙类基因组
steps.text: The Xenopus tropicalis draft assembly is a valuable genomic reference tied to a traceable accession. It represents one living species and a bounded sample, not the genomes of all amphibians.
steps.textZh: Xenopus tropicalis 的草图组装是有价值、可由登录号追溯的基因组参考。它代表一个现生物种和有界样本，并非所有两栖动物的基因组。
steps.annotation: Extant genomic comparison does not directly observe lineage origins.

steps.title: Receptor knockouts affect organs differently
steps.titleZh: 受体敲除对不同器官影响不同
steps.text: In the experiment, loss of TRβ delayed tail regression, while loss of TRα advanced hindlimb development. The results reveal receptor- and tissue-specific effects in this laboratory model, not a universal rule for amphibians.
steps.textZh: 实验中，缺失 TRβ 会延缓尾部退化，而缺失 TRα 会加快后肢发育。结果显示这一实验模型中受体和组织作用不同，不能概括为所有两栖动物的普遍规律。
steps.annotation: Experimental causation in one laboratory model is not a universal amphibian rule.

steps.title: Molecular data and taxonomy shape the timetree
steps.titleZh: 分子数据与分类推断共同塑造时间树
steps.text: The posterior timetree includes 7,238 species: molecular data cover 4,061, while the rest enter through soft taxonomic inference. Its node ages are model estimates, not fossil dates or directly observed events.
steps.textZh: 后验时间树覆盖 7,238 个物种：4,061 个有分子数据，其余通过软分类推断纳入。树上节点年代是模型估计，不是化石年龄或直接观察到的事件。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 naming coverage, sequence sampling and mature evidence dossiers remain different inventories.

dekZh: 蛙类基因组、受体敲除实验和覆盖 7,238 个物种的时间树回答不同问题；它们都不是祖先关系的化石记录，也没有覆盖所有两栖动物。

title: Seven evidence boundaries from synapsids to mammals
titleZh: 从合弓类到哺乳动物的七条证据边界
dek: Follow named specimens, CT datasets, character matrices and living experiments while keeping anatomy, topology, function, crown membership and time explicitly separate.
dekZh: 从具名标本、CT 数据、性状矩阵到现生动物实验，逐步区分解剖、亲缘位置、功能、冠群成员资格和年代。

steps.title: One referred spine, not a finished sail
steps.titleZh: 一节转介的脊椎，不等于完整背帆
steps.text: ROM VP 83326 records striking neural-spine elongation in a referred early synapsid. Missing surrounding anatomy prevents the specimen from fixing whole-body proportions, function or a lineage-wide first appearance.
steps.textZh: ROM VP 83326 显示一件被归入早期合弓类的标本具有显著延长的神经棘。周围骨骼缺失，因此它不能确定全身比例、背帆功能，也不能证明这一性状何时首次出现在整个谱系。
steps.annotation: A referred bone, a reconstructed body outline and a proposed sail function are three different evidence levels.

steps.title: A fragment enters a character matrix
steps.titleZh: 一块碎片进入性状矩阵
steps.text: The partial snout IVPP V15424 was recovered beside the remaining sampled therapsids in one 71-character analysis. That topology is reproducible evidence, not direct ancestry or a precisely dated origin event.
steps.textZh: IVPP V15424 是一件不完整吻部；在一项含 71 项性状的分析中，它与其余受采样的兽孔类一起进入矩阵。这个拓扑结果可以复现，但不是直接祖先关系，也没有精确定出起源时间。
steps.annotation: The paper itself warns that the Dashankou sequence lacks reliable radiometric dates.

steps.title: Two cynodont samples reject a simple ladder
steps.titleZh: 两组犬齿兽样本打破简单阶梯
steps.text: Riograndia has dentary–squamosal contact while the nine-specimen Brasilodon sample lacks it. The distribution supports iterative acquisition, and contact alone neither creates a crown mammal nor proves modern joint function.
steps.textZh: Riograndia 有齿骨与鳞骨接触；包含九件标本的 Brasilodon 样本却没有这种接触。分布模式支持该特征曾反复出现。单有接触既不能把动物归为冠群哺乳动物，也不能证明现代颌关节功能。
steps.annotation: The 225.42 ± 0.37 Ma value is a maximum depositional age, not a direct fossil date.

steps.title: Crown membership is a tested topology
steps.titleZh: 冠群成员资格来自拓扑检验
steps.text: CT anatomy and wear from MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95 reshaped a published matrix that placed Haramiyavia outside crown Mammalia. The placement belongs to that analysis, while the jaw surface only indirectly supports auditory anatomy.
steps.textZh: 对 MCZ7/95A–B 和 MCZ10/G95 的 CT 解剖及磨耗观察，改变了一项已发表矩阵中 Haramiyavia 位于冠群哺乳动物之外的结果。这个位置属于该项分析；颌面只能间接提示听觉结构，不能直接显示软组织。
steps.annotation: A matrix placement, a crown calibration and an anatomical observation are not interchangeable.

steps.title: Separate fossils show separate mosaics
steps.titleZh: 不同化石保存不同的颌耳组合
steps.text: Dianoconodon and Feredocodon preserve different jaw–ear combinations across two formations and times. Their comparison supports a load shift, but it is not a continuous transformation series or an ancestor–descendant pair.
steps.textZh: Dianoconodon 与 Feredocodon 来自不同地层和年代，保存的颌骨—耳骨组合也不同。比较支持受力方式发生转移的解释，但这不是连续的变化序列，更不是一对祖先与后代。
steps.annotation: Preserved contacts support, but do not directly measure, biting and hearing performance.

steps.title: Detached bones can retain a cartilage link
steps.titleZh: 分离的骨骼仍由软骨连接
steps.text: IVPP V16051 preserves ectotympanic and malleus elements separated from direct dentary contact yet connected by ossified Meckel's cartilage. One articulated skeleton documents a mosaic, not a universal evolutionary stage.
steps.textZh: IVPP V16051 中，鼓骨与锤骨已脱离与齿骨的直接接触，却仍被骨化的梅克尔软骨连接。一具关节相连的骨架记录了性状镶嵌，不代表所有哺乳动物都经历同一个阶段。
steps.annotation: Anatomical connection is observed; stabilization and auditory effects remain functional inference.

steps.title: Living development tests a mechanism, not ancestry
steps.titleZh: 现生发育实验检验机制，不检验祖先
steps.text: Mouse genetics and opossum inhibition experiments show that disrupting clast-cell activity can retain a jaw–ear cartilage connection. They illuminate a possible mechanism without replaying a particular fossil or proving its ancient cause.
steps.textZh: 小鼠遗传实验和负鼠抑制实验显示，干扰破骨细胞活动会保留颌骨与耳骨之间的软骨连接。它们说明一种可能机制，却没有重演某件化石的发育，也不能证明古代变化由同一原因造成。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 assigns zero accepted species directly to mammal-origins because living Mammalia route to order-specific or other-mammals packages and Synapsida lacks a reliable materialized species root. Zero is a package-routing boundary.

title: Three reptile radiations, ten evidence dossiers
titleZh: 三次爬行动物辐射与十个证据档案
dek: Keep ichthyosaurs, plesiosaurs and pterosaurs as three independent radiations, and compare an older uncertain Bobosaurus candidate with diagnostic Rhaeticosaurus without turning either into a direct ancestor.

steps.title: A small ichthyosauromorph with a short snout
steps.titleZh: 短吻小型鱼龙形类保存的身体
steps.text: AGM I-1 preserves a small body with a short snout, large flippers, and dense limb and rib bones. Amphibious habits and suction feeding are functional interpretations; the specimen records neither behaviour nor direct ancestry.
steps.textZh: AGM I-1 保存了一具短吻小型身体、大型鳍肢以及致密的肢骨和肋骨。两栖习性与吸力摄食是功能解释；标本本身没有记录行为，也不能证明直接祖先关系。
steps.annotation: The corrigendum is part of the evidence record; it changed character descriptions and tree statistics while retaining the reported topology.

steps.title: Embryos support pregnancy, not a complete birth story
steps.titleZh: 胚胎支持怀孕，却不能还原完整分娩过程
steps.text: Chaohusaurus specimen AGM I-1 preserves two embryos inside the mother and a nearby neonate. The association supports pregnancy. Head-first delivery and a terrestrial origin for live birth are comparative inferences, not observations from this specimen.
steps.textZh: Chaohusaurus 标本 AGM I-1 保存了母体内的两枚胚胎和旁边的一只新生个体。这种关联支持怀孕。头先产出以及胎生起源于陆地仍是比较推断，并非标本直接显示的过程。
steps.annotation: A specimen-level reproductive record does not define the ancestral state of all marine reptiles.

steps.title: One Jurassic ichthyosaur preserves skin chemistry
steps.titleZh: 一件侏罗纪鱼龙保存了皮肤化学线索
steps.text: MH 432 preserves skin layers, a blubber-like layer beneath the skin, and structures containing eumelanin pigment. Countershading and thermoregulation are interpretations based on their distribution and comparisons with living animals, not measured physiology.
steps.textZh: MH 432 保存了皮肤层、类似鲸脂的皮下层，以及含有真黑素的结构。根据这些结构的分布并与现生动物比较，研究者提出反荫蔽和体温调节解释；这不是直接测得的生理数据。
steps.annotation: One exceptional specimen does not establish a universal tissue condition for Ichthyosauria.

steps.title: An older fossil can still be hard to place
steps.titleZh: 化石年代较早，分类位置仍难确定
steps.text: Early Carnian Bobosaurus combines features compared with nothosaurs and plesiosaurs, while alternative tree positions remain viable. It is an older candidate near the plesiosaur lineage, not proof that diagnostic Plesiosauria reached back into the Carnian.
steps.textZh: 早卡尼期的 Bobosaurus 兼有与幻龙类和蛇颈龙类比较的特征，但在树上的其他位置仍然可行。它是接近蛇颈龙支系的较早候选者，并不能证明典型蛇颈龙类已延伸到卡尼期。
steps.annotation: Compare this uncertain candidate with the separately documented Rhaetian Rhaeticosaurus skeleton.

steps.title: A Rhaetian skeleton adds anatomy and bone tissue
steps.titleZh: 瑞替期骨架补充了解剖与骨组织证据
steps.text: LWL-MFN P 64047 preserves an articulated skeleton and vascularized tissue in a long bone from the Rhaetian. Its proposed basal position among pliosaurids and the physiological meaning of the tissue depend on phylogenetic and histological interpretation.
steps.textZh: LWL-MFN P 64047 保存了关节相连的骨骼，以及长骨中的血管化组织，年代为瑞替期。它在系统树上的基础上龙科位置及骨组织的生理含义，都取决于系统发育和组织学解释。
steps.annotation: A named Triassic skeleton is not automatically the global first occurrence or a direct ancestor of later plesiosaurs.

steps.title: One fetus records plesiosaur pregnancy
steps.titleZh: 一枚胎儿标本记录了蛇颈龙怀孕
steps.text: The adult Polycotylus LACM 129639 contains one large articulated fetus identified as the same taxon. The specimen supports pregnancy and live birth; parental care, sociality, and a K-selected life-history strategy are broader hypotheses based on comparison.
steps.textZh: 成年 Polycotylus 标本 LACM 129639 内有一枚大型、关节相连且被鉴定为同种的胎儿。标本支持怀孕和胎生；亲代照料、群居以及 K 策略生活史则是更宽泛的类比假说。
steps.annotation: Preserved reproductive anatomy and inferred life-history strategy have different evidentiary strength.

steps.title: A water-channel model tests four-flipper mechanics
steps.titleZh: 水槽模型检验四鳍游动的力学
steps.text: A physical model measured thrust and efficiency while researchers set the timing between fore- and hind-flipper strokes. Interacting vortices show that the proposed mechanics are plausible; they do not record an extinct animal's gait or a stroke shared by every plesiosaur.
steps.textZh: 实体模型在研究者设定前肢与后肢鳍摆动时序差的条件下测量推力和效率。涡旋相互作用说明这种机制在力学上可行，却没有记录灭绝动物的真实步态，也不能代表所有蛇颈龙采用同一种划水方式。
steps.annotation: Model inputs, measured outputs and palaeobiological extrapolation remain separate.

steps.title: One skull preserves branched structures and melanosomes
steps.titleZh: 一件头骨保存分枝结构与黑素体
steps.text: MCT.R.1884 preserves unbranched filaments, branched feather-like structures, and melanosomes around a Tupandactylus skull and crest. These remains do not directly recover exact colours or show that all pterosaurs had the same covering.
steps.textZh: MCT.R.1884 在 Tupandactylus 头骨和头冠周围保存了不分枝丝状结构、羽状分枝结构及黑素体。这些遗存无法直接恢复精确颜色，也不能说明所有翼龙都具有相同体表覆盖物。
steps.annotation: Preserved structures, colour-function hypotheses and reconstructed ancestral states are different claim types.

steps.title: The egg block preserves embryos in a larger assemblage
steps.titleZh: 蛋块与胚胎属于更大的化石组合
steps.text: A Hamipterus block exposes 215 eggs and may contain about 300. Sixteen eggs from the wider assemblage preserve embryonic remains at multiple stages. Nesting, transport, and hatchling behaviour remain interpretations of the site and fossils.
steps.textZh: 一块 Hamipterus 化石露出 215 枚蛋，估计可能约有 300 枚。更大的化石组合中有 16 枚蛋保存了多个阶段的胚胎遗存。筑巢、搬运和幼体行为仍属于对遗址和化石的解释。
steps.annotation: Egg and embryo counts do not by themselves demonstrate parental care or post-hatching flight capacity.

steps.title: A model tests whether a giant pterosaur could launch on four limbs
steps.titleZh: 模型检验巨型翼龙能否四肢助跑起飞
steps.text: Scaling estimates, bone mechanics, and aerodynamic calculations test powered flight and forelimb-assisted launch in selected giant-pterosaur reconstructions. The result is a feasibility model, not direct observation of an extinct takeoff.
steps.textZh: 研究者用尺度估算、骨骼力学和空气动力计算，检验选定巨型翼龙复原模型中的动力飞行与前肢助力起飞是否可行。结果是可行性模型，不是对灭绝动物真实起飞过程的直接观察。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 contributes zero accepted species through these fossil-root routes; naming coverage does not establish species-specific evidence, and the three radiations remain separate.

title: Eight whale-transition dossiers without an ancestor ladder
titleZh: 不构成祖先阶梯的八个鲸类转型档案
dek: Named fossil samples track changes in whale anatomy. Each case asks a different question, from movement and dispersal to relationships among living species.
overviewZh: 具名化石样本记录了鲸类身体结构的变化。每个案例回答不同问题，从运动与扩散到现生物种之间的亲缘关系。

steps.title: Several samples support one bounded inference
steps.titleZh: 多种样本支持有限推断
steps.text: RR 207 and RR 208 skulls, separate dense limb bones and tooth isotopes support aquatic wading and raoellid affinity. They are not one skeleton, crown whales or proof that Indohyus directly became a whale.
steps.textZh: RR 207 与 RR 208 的头骨、另行发现的高密度肢骨和牙齿同位素，支持水中涉行与 Raoellidae 亲缘解释。它们不是同一具骨架、冠群鲸类化石，也不能证明 Indohyus 直接演化成鲸。
steps.annotation: Specimens, ecological interpretation and matrix placement remain separate evidence levels.

steps.title: A reconstruction can combine individuals
steps.titleZh: 复原图可以组合不同个体
steps.text: Pakicetus skull H-GSP 96231 and separately catalogued postcranial bones from Locality 62 support a terrestrial body plan. The published outline is a composite, not one articulated animal or a direct ancestor.
steps.textZh: Pakicetus 头骨 H-GSP 96231 与来自 62 号地点、另行编目的颅后骨骼，共同支持陆生体型复原。论文中的轮廓图是组合复原，不是一具关节相连的动物，也不代表直接祖先。
steps.annotation: The 2001 morphology tree and the independent 1999 retroposon tree answer different sampled questions.

steps.title: One holotype, a locomotor mosaic
steps.titleZh: 一件正模呈现运动拼图
steps.text: H-GSP 18507 preserves an amphibious combination of vertebral and limb anatomy. Otter-like swimming and sea-lion-like terrestrial motion are functional models, not observed strokes or gait.
steps.textZh: H-GSP 18507 保存了兼有水陆特征的脊椎和肢骨组合。类似水獭的游泳与类似海狮的陆地运动属于功能模型，不是直接观察到的游泳动作或步态。
steps.annotation: A named specimen can constrain mechanical possibility without recording behaviour.

steps.title: A dated occurrence is firmer than a route
steps.titleZh: 有年代的出现记录比路线更确定
steps.text: MUSM 3580 fixes a roughly 42.6 Ma protocetid occurrence in Peru and preserves weight-bearing anatomy. Its walking, swimming and westward Atlantic dispersal narratives are tested interpretations, not a filmed journey.
steps.textZh: MUSM 3580 将秘鲁的原鲸科出现记录定位在约 42.6 Ma，并保存了承重特征。行走、游泳和向西越过大西洋的扩散路线都是依据标本提出的解释，而非化石直接记录的旅程。
steps.annotation: The paper explicitly leaves an eastward route and the presence of a tail fluke unresolved.

steps.title: A tiny foot is not a walking foot
steps.titleZh: 小型足部不等于陆行证据
steps.text: Basilosaurus retains a miniature jointed pelvic limb and foot, and UM 93231 preserves measurable femoral microstructure. Neither establishes terrestrial locomotion; copulatory use remains inferred.
steps.textZh: Basilosaurus 保留了微小但关节相连的骨盆肢和足，UM 93231 则保存可测量的股骨显微结构。两者都不能证明陆地行走；用于交配的功能仍属推断。
steps.annotation: Preserved anatomy, measured tissue and proposed function are three distinct claims.

steps.title: Tail propulsion without a preserved fluke
steps.titleZh: 推测尾部推进，但尾鳍未保存
steps.text: CGM 60584 records unfused sacrals, no weight-bearing sacroiliac joint, posterior vertebral elongation and reduced limbs. Greater tail propulsion is inferred, while a fluke is doubtful and not preserved.
steps.textZh: CGM 60584 保存未融合的荐椎、不能承重的荐髂关节、后段椎骨延长和缩小的肢体。尾部推进增强是推断，尾鳍则未保存且存在疑问。
steps.annotation: The source itself discloses conflicting age indicators around the Bartonian–Priabonian boundary.

steps.title: Living genomes test a branch, not an age
steps.titleZh: 现生基因组检验亲缘分支
steps.text: Independent retroposon insertions support Hippopotamidae as the living sister group of Cetacea. The sampled topology does not identify a direct ancestor, date the split or place every fossil relative.
steps.textZh: 独立的逆转座子插入支持河马科是现生鲸类的姐妹群。这个取样拓扑不能识别直系祖先、确定分化年代，也不能放置每一种化石近亲。
steps.annotation: Molecular topology and fossil character placement remain independently inspectable.

steps.title: A molecular tree and a species catalogue answer different questions
steps.titleZh: 分子树与物种名录回答不同问题
steps.text: The 42,335-character supermatrix sampled 87 of 89 cetacean species recognized in 2009. Its tree and clock estimates are model results; the current COL26.8 accepted-name list organizes names, not molecular relationships or fossil evidence.
steps.textZh: 42,335 个字符的超矩阵取样了 2009 年所承认 89 个鲸类物种中的 87 个。系统树和分子钟年代是模型结果；当前 COL26.8 接受名录整理名称，并不提供分子亲缘或化石证据。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 503 strictly accepted species through the package's exact Artiodactyla and Cetacea usage roots; that is naming coverage, not 503 molecular trees, fossil dossiers or reviewed ranges.

dekZh: 具名化石样本记录了鲸类解剖结构的变化。每个案例探讨的问题各不相同，涉及运动、扩散以及现生物种之间的亲缘关系。

title: Nine evidence mosaics in turtle and lepidosaur origins
titleZh: 龟类与鳞龙起源的九组证据镶嵌
dek: Move from named bones and CT volumes to competing matrices, clock calibrations and explicit Mosasauroidea–Mosasauridae boundaries without turning separate fossils into an ancestor ladder.

steps.title: Rib growth helps test how the turtle shell formed
steps.titleZh: 肋骨生长帮助检验龟壳的形成
steps.text: NHM PV R 4949 preserves successive layers of bone in a broadened Eunotosaurus rib; other specimens preserve shoulder bones. The tissue is observed directly, while its homology, function, and place on the turtle stem are tested interpretations.
steps.textZh: NHM PV R 4949 保存了宽化 Eunotosaurus 肋骨中逐层沉积的骨组织；其他标本则保存肩带骨骼。组织结构是直接观察到的，肋骨的同源关系、功能和龟类干群位置仍属待检验的解释。
steps.annotation: Separate preserved tissue from a character-homology model and from direct ancestry.

steps.title: Paired belly bones are not a complete shell
steps.titleZh: 成对腹骨不等于完整龟壳
steps.text: The Vellberg Pappochelys sample combines broad ribs with strong, paired gastralia—belly bones—but has neither a fused plastron nor a complete carapace. Their proposed relationship to shell bones is a homology hypothesis, not a literal stage in an ancestor sequence.
steps.textZh: Vellberg 的 Pappochelys 样本兼有宽肋骨和坚实的成对腹肋，却没有融合的腹甲或完整背甲。它们与龟壳骨骼之间的关系是同源假说，不是祖先序列中真实可见的一步。
steps.annotation: A multi-specimen reconstruction is not one individual transforming into a later taxon.

steps.title: A plastron is preserved without a complete carapace
steps.titleZh: 保存了腹甲，却没有完整背甲
steps.text: Three Odontochelys specimens preserve a developed plastron, expanded ribs, and neural plates, but no complete carapace. The proposed order of shell formation and a marginal-marine habitat are interpretations; fossils do not show anatomy changing through time.
steps.textZh: 三件 Odontochelys 标本保存了发育的腹甲、扩展的肋骨和神经板，但没有完整背甲。先形成腹甲的顺序以及近岸海洋生活环境都属于解释；化石没有记录解剖结构随时间变化的过程。
steps.annotation: Shell elements, environmental setting and a proposed evolutionary order are distinct claim layers.

steps.title: One fossil supplies a minimum age, not an origin date
steps.titleZh: 一件化石提供最低年代，不是起源时间
steps.text: Caribemys holotype MNHNCu P-3209 supplies a 155.6 Ma hard minimum for crown Testudines in one best-practice analysis. A much older posterior age comes from a relaxed molecular clock and depends on the tree and its priors; it is not a directly dated fossil origin.
steps.textZh: Caribemys 正模 MNHNCu P-3209 在一项最佳实践分析中为龟鳖类冠群提供了 1.556 亿年前的硬性最小年代。更早的后验估计来自松弛分子钟，并取决于系统树和先验；它不是直接测得的化石起源时间。
steps.annotation: A fossil minimum, a maximum prior and a posterior node age are three different quantities.

steps.title: A CT-scanned skull is tested in several trees
steps.titleZh: CT 扫描头骨进入多棵系统树
steps.text: Micro-CT reveals the mix of cranial features in Taytalura holotype PVSJ 698. Several analyses place it on the lepidosauromorph stem, but one skull does not provide whole-body anatomy, prove direct ancestry, or establish a global range.
steps.textZh: 微型 CT 显示 Taytalura 正模 PVSJ 698 的头骨性状组合。多项分析将它置于鳞龙形类干群，但单一头骨不能提供完整身体解剖、证明直接祖先关系或确立全球分布。
steps.annotation: The scan volume is specimen evidence; the tree position is an analytical output.

steps.title: One fossil joins anatomical and molecular datasets
steps.titleZh: 一件化石连接形态与分子数据集
steps.text: CT anatomy of Megachirella PZO 628 was combined with fossil morphology and DNA data from living species. The analysis places it on the squamate stem and estimates deeper divergence times; neither result is a directly observed first appearance of the crown group.
steps.textZh: 研究将 Megachirella PZO 628 的 CT 解剖与化石形态数据和现生种 DNA 数据结合。分析把它置于有鳞类干群并估计更深分化时间；两者都不是直接观察到的冠群首次出现年代。
steps.annotation: Fossil anatomy, molecular constraint and clock time remain separately labelled.

steps.title: A near-complete skeleton still combines different traits
steps.titleZh: 近乎完整的骨架仍呈现不同性状组合
steps.text: Synchrotron scans of Bellairsia NMS G.2022.1.1 reveal both crown-like and retained features in one Jurassic skeleton. Its stem placement and proposed skull movement depend on character matrices and functional interpretation.
steps.textZh: Bellairsia 标本 NMS G.2022.1.1 的同步辐射扫描显示同一件侏罗纪骨架既有冠群特征，也保留其他性状。其干群位置和头骨运动假说取决于性状矩阵与功能解释。
steps.annotation: Completeness improves observation but does not remove topology or function uncertainty.

steps.title: Researchers disagree about the same fossil
steps.titleZh: 研究者对同一件化石意见不一
steps.text: Researchers disagree about the bones, referred material, and character scores for Cryptovaranoides NHMUK PV R36822. Their analyses produce both crown-squamate and non-squamate trees, so the fossil's position remains contested rather than establishing a secure Triassic first appearance for crown squamates.
steps.textZh: 研究者对 Cryptovaranoides 标本 NHMUK PV R36822 的骨骼、归入材料和性状评分存在分歧。不同分析分别得到冠群有鳞类树与非有鳞类树，因此其位置仍有争议，不能据此确立可靠的三叠纪冠群有鳞类首现年代。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 assigns 12,622 accepted living species to this package as a nomenclatural routing snapshot; fossil topology and per-species evidence require their own cited records.

steps.title: A broad mosasaur group differs from the named family
steps.titleZh: 广义沧龙类群不等于沧龙科
steps.text: Under the cited definitions, Mosasauroidea is broader than the node-defined family Mosasauridae. Dallasaurus retains relatively unspecialized, plesiopedal limbs, so its family placement and the evolution of fully paddle-shaped limbs are separate questions.
steps.textZh: 按照所引定义，Mosasauroidea 的范围宽于以节点定义的 Mosasauridae。Dallasaurus 仍保留相对未特化的肢体，因此它是否属于该科与四肢是否已完全特化为桨状是两个不同问题。
steps.annotation: The Mosasauroidea navigation edge is non-taxonomic for discovery; basal topology remains analysis-sensitive.

title: Crocodile-line and bird-line archosaurs: eleven evidence cases
titleZh: 鳄类支与鸟类支主龙类：十一种证据
dek: Compare crocodile-line and bird-line records while keeping fossils, experiments, trees, clocks and living-name catalogues distinct.
dekZh: 从鳄类支化石到现生鸟类数据集，比较标本、实验与模型各自能说明什么。

steps.title: A crocodile-line body can mimic a theropod
steps.text: AMNH FR 30587 preserves a slender, toothless suchian, a crocodile-line archosaur. Its body proportions resemble those of ornithomimid dinosaurs, but the resemblance is convergence: similar form evolved on separate branches. It does not establish an immediate shared ancestor or identical ecology.
steps.titleZh: 鳄类支身体也会演化出似兽脚类的外形
steps.textZh: AMNH FR 30587 保存了一只纤细、无齿的 suchian，即鳄类支主龙。它的身体比例类似似鸟龙类恐龙，但这种相似属于趋同演化：两个分支分别演化出相近形态。它不能证明两者有直接的近期共同祖先，也不能说明生态相同。
steps.annotation: Effigia is a pseudosuchian outside Crocodylomorpha, so it remains event evidence rather than a false child of the crocodile navigation node.

steps.title: Carnufex: a partial fossil, a bounded predator claim
steps.text: NCSM 21558 is a partial holotype of a large Carnian crocodylomorph, a member of the crocodile-related archosaur line. Its proposed size and high predator tier are inferred from proxies and the fossil assemblage around it; the specimen does not preserve a feeding event. The predator interpretation is therefore bounded by indirect evidence.
steps.titleZh: Carnufex：残缺化石能支持多强的捕食者判断？
steps.textZh: NCSM 21558 是大型卡尼期鳄形类的部分正模；鳄形类属于鳄类亲缘的主龙支系。其体型和较高捕食者级别来自替代指标及伴生化石组合的推断；标本本身没有保存摄食事件。因此，捕食者解释受到间接证据的限制。
steps.annotation: Incomplete and immature anatomy cannot establish a direct ancestor or universal global first occurrence.

steps.title: Junggarsuchus: skull and trunk tell different things
steps.text: Junggarsuchus holotype IVPP V14010 combines a consolidated skull resembling that of crocodylians with a slender, land-adapted postcranial skeleton. Those parts form one anatomical mosaic. Functional claims about skull mechanics or fast running, and its exact tree position, remain interpretations based on anatomy and character analysis.
steps.titleZh: Junggarsuchus：头骨与躯干给出不同线索
steps.textZh: Junggarsuchus 正模 IVPP V14010 将类似鳄类的致密头骨与纤细、适于陆地的头后骨骼组合在一起。这是一种身体结构镶嵌。关于头骨力学、快速奔跑及其精确系统位置的说法，仍是基于解剖和性状分析的解释。
steps.annotation: Skull mechanics and cursoriality are functional interpretations; topology is character-matrix evidence.

steps.title: A dated model tests gharial relationships
steps.text: One tip-dated model—a time-tree method that assigns ages to sampled fossils at the tree tips—combines fossil ages and morphology with molecular data from living crocodilians. It groups Gavialis, the gharial, with Tomistoma, the false gharial, and places the sampled thoracosaurs outside the crocodilian crown group, defined by the last common ancestor of living crocodilians and all its descendants. Other analyses recover different relationships, so the result is a model test rather than a settled genealogy.
steps.titleZh: 定年模型检验长吻鳄类的亲缘关系
steps.textZh: 一项端点定年模型——把年龄赋给系统树末端所取样化石的时间树方法——将化石年代、形态与现生鳄类的分子数据结合起来。模型将长吻鳄 Gavialis 与马来鳄 Tomistoma 归在一起，并把所取样的 thoracosaurs 放在鳄类冠群之外；冠群由现生鳄类最近共同祖先及其所有后代构成。其他分析得出不同关系，因此这只是模型检验，并非定论的谱系历史。
steps.annotation: A preferred topology is not an observed genealogy; priors, weights and sampled characters remain visible boundaries.

steps.title: Archaeopteryx shows mixed anatomical signals
steps.text: The Thermopolis specimen WDC CSG 100 preserves theropod-like features in the feet and palate alongside avialan, or bird-line, anatomy. This combination supports close evolutionary affinity between birds and theropod dinosaurs. It does not make this individual the uniquely first bird or a directly observed ancestor.
steps.titleZh: 始祖鸟保存了混合的解剖信号
steps.textZh: Thermopolis 标本 WDC CSG 100 同时保存了兽脚类样的足部和腭部特征，以及鸟翼类即鸟类支的解剖结构。这种组合支持鸟类与兽脚类恐龙的近缘关系，但不能把这一个体认定为唯一的“第一只鸟”或已直接观察到的祖先。
steps.annotation: Joint posture, perching and exact placement are interpretations rather than direct observations.

steps.title: Pigment structures constrain a feather-colour map
steps.text: Microscopy of BMNHC PH828 identified melanosomes, pigment-associated structures whose shapes can be compared with reference samples. A statistical analysis used them to reconstruct likely plumage regions. Preservation quality and the use of a tail from another specimen constrain how completely the colour map represents Anchiornis.
steps.titleZh: 显微结构约束羽色复原
steps.textZh: 对 BMNHC PH828 的显微观察发现了黑素体；这些与色素有关的结构可按形态同参照样本比较。统计分析据此复原可能的羽毛分区。化石保存状况，以及复原中借用了另一件标本的尾部，都限制了这幅羽色图能代表多少。
steps.annotation: Anchiornis remains a non-avian paravian event here, not a false child of Aves or a directly observed ancestral colour state.

steps.title: Feathers cover four limb surfaces in one fossil
steps.text: Microraptor specimen IVPP V13352 preserves long pennaceous, vane-bearing feathers on the forelimbs, hindlimbs and tail. The fossil documents where feathers occur on this individual. It does not preserve a flight path or directly show how the animal moved through the air.
steps.titleZh: 一件化石保存了四肢表面的羽毛
steps.textZh: Microraptor 标本 IVPP V13352 在前肢、后肢和尾部保存了长而具羽片的正羽。化石记录的是这一个体哪些部位有羽毛；它没有保存飞行轨迹，也没有直接显示动物如何在空中运动。
steps.annotation: Microraptor is treated as a non-avian paravian dossier, not a direct bird ancestor.

steps.title: A wind tunnel tests one reconstructed glide
steps.text: Researchers measured forces on a scaled Microraptor model and found stable, high-drag gliding across the configurations they tested. The result shows that this reconstructed geometry can glide under those conditions. Scaling, body posture, model shape and fossil distortion bound the experiment; it is not a recording of extinct behaviour.
steps.titleZh: 风洞检验一种复原姿态是否可滑翔
steps.textZh: 研究者测量按比例缩小的 Microraptor 模型所受的力，发现在测试的几种构型下可以稳定地进行高阻力滑翔。结果说明这种复原形状在这些条件下具有滑翔可行性。比例缩放、身体姿态、模型形状和化石变形都会限制实验；它并非灭绝动物行为的录像。
steps.annotation: Geometry, scaling, reconstructed posture and fossil distortion bound every aerodynamic conclusion.

steps.title: A tightly dated fossil, two crown-bird placements
steps.text: CT imaging of Asteriornis holotype NHMM 2013 008 supplies skull anatomy for testing its position near Galloanserae, the group that includes waterfowl and landfowl. Parsimony and tip-dated Bayesian analyses place it on different nearby branches. Its tight age is valuable, but does not by itself make it the globally oldest crown bird or settle whether it falls within the crown group of living birds and their descendants.
steps.titleZh: 定年精确的化石，却有两种冠群鸟类位置
steps.textZh: 对 Asteriornis 正模 NHMM 2013 008 进行 CT 成像，提供了检验其是否接近雁形类的头骨资料；雁形类包括水禽和陆禽。简约法与端点定年贝叶斯分析把它放在相邻但不同的分支。精确年代很有价值，却不能单独证明它是全球最早的冠群鸟类，也不能解决它是否属于现生鸟类最近共同祖先及其后代构成的冠群。
steps.annotation: A tightly dated occurrence is not automatically the globally oldest modern bird, and crown membership remains analysis-dependent.

steps.title: Neoavian genomes expose gene-tree conflict
steps.text: A whole-genome analysis sampled 48 representatives across Neoaves, the large living-bird group, and recovered major groupings. Individual gene trees still conflict over some branches, so the result is a topology for a selected extant sample, not a complete species tree or a record of fossil ancestry.
steps.titleZh: 新鸟类基因组仍显示基因树冲突
steps.textZh: 一项全基因组分析从 Neoaves（大型现生鸟类类群）各目取样 48 个代表，恢复了现生鸟类的主要类群关系。但一些分支在不同基因树中仍有冲突，因此结果只代表精选现生样本的系统关系，并非完整物种树或化石祖先记录。
steps.annotation: Incomplete lineage sorting, convergence, sampling and method choice remain explicit.

steps.title: A modern-bird time tree rests on calibrations
steps.text: A fossil-calibrated analysis combines clock-like exons, broader RAG (recombination-activating gene) sampling and fossil constraints to infer a Cretaceous root and radiation around the Cretaceous–Palaeogene boundary. Its dates follow the chosen calibrations, topology and priors. COL26.8’s 11,071 accepted living species describe the package’s nomenclatural coverage, not fossil completeness, direct ancestry or agreement on one crown-bird date.
steps.titleZh: 现生鸟类时间树依赖校准
steps.textZh: 一项化石校准分析结合近似时钟行为的外显子、更广的 RAG（重组激活基因）取样和化石约束，推断鸟类冠群根部位于白垩纪，并在白垩纪—古近纪界线附近发生辐射。年代取决于所选校准、拓扑和先验条件。COL26.8 收录的 11,071 个现生接受名代表该数据包的命名覆盖范围，不代表化石记录完整、直系祖先关系或某个冠群鸟类年代已获一致认可。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 11,071 accepted living species into this package. That is a nomenclatural coverage boundary, not fossil completeness, direct ancestry or agreement on a single crown-bird date.

title: Twelve primate dossiers without an ancestor ladder
titleZh: 不构成祖先阶梯的十二个灵长类档案
dek: Move from a calibration-sensitive crown model through named fossils and ancient genomes while keeping specimens, functions, topology, model time and COL26.8 naming coverage distinct.
dekZh: 从对校准敏感的冠群模型，到具名化石与古基因组；阅读时要分清标本、功能、亲缘拓扑、模型年代，以及 COL26.8 的名称覆盖范围。

steps.title: A crown interval is not a fossil
steps.titleZh: 冠群区间不是化石
steps.text: The selected clock model places crown Primates at 79.2–70.0 Ma, while another calibration strategy spans 71.4–63.9 Ma. Neither interval is a fossil occurrence.
steps.textZh: 本页选用的分子钟模型把冠群灵长类估在 79.2–70.0 Ma；另一种化石校准方案给出 71.4–63.9 Ma。两个区间都是模型估计，不是化石出现记录。
steps.annotation: Clock and fossil priors materially change deep-node ages.

steps.title: An ankle attribution is bounded
steps.titleZh: 踝骨归属有明确边界
steps.text: UCMP 197509, UCMP 197517 and related isolated tarsals preserve arboreal morphology. Their attribution to Purgatorius does not make them crown primates or a global first appearance.
steps.textZh: UCMP 197509、UCMP 197517 和相关分离跗骨保留了树栖形态。把它们归于 Purgatorius，并不等于证明它们属于冠群灵长类，也不代表全球最早出现。
steps.annotation: Isolated tarsals, dental attribution and functional inference are three steps.

steps.title: Ten teeth do not settle a crown
steps.titleZh: 十颗牙齿仍不足以定论
steps.text: THR 141 and a small isolated-tooth hypodigm define Altiatlasius, but tooth positions, membership and euprimate placement remain disputed.
steps.textZh: THR 141 和少量分离牙齿构成 Altiatlasius 的已知标本组合，但牙齿位置、哪些牙属于该组合，以及它是否属于真灵长类都仍有争议。
steps.annotation: The existence of specimens is firmer than their topology.

steps.title: A correlated sequence is not one migration
steps.titleZh: 对应的地层序列不等于一次迁徙
steps.text: Asian, European and North American Teilhardina samples align to the PETM in a rapid appearance sequence, without recording one travelling lineage.
steps.textZh: 亚洲、欧洲和北美的 Teilhardina 样本可与古新世—始新世极热事件对应，形成快速出现的序列；这些样本没有记录同一条谱系迁徙的过程。
steps.annotation: Dental taxonomy and isotope correlation bound the dispersal inference.

steps.title: A digit can constrain function
steps.titleZh: 一根趾骨可以约束功能解释
steps.text: AMNH 143612/143640 preserves a ray-identified foot; digit-two phalanx AMNH 143612-03 supports a grooming-claw comparison, not crown-anthropoid ancestry.
steps.textZh: AMNH 143612/143640 保存了可辨认趾列的足部；第二趾趾节 AMNH 143612-03 支持与梳理爪的比较，但不能证明冠群人猿类祖先关系。
steps.annotation: Preserved phalanx geometry is distinct from behaviour and topology.

steps.title: One skeleton, two slabs and a disclosure
steps.titleZh: 一具骨架、两块石板与一项披露
steps.text: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are opposite slabs of one Darwinius skeleton. Fabricated preparation on part of the counterplate is disclosed and crown placement remains contested.
steps.textZh: PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 是同一具 Darwinius 骨架的两面石板。反面石板部分经过人为修饰，资料已披露；它是否位于冠群灵长类中的位置仍有争论。
steps.annotation: Exceptional completeness does not remove preparation and topology limits.

steps.title: Postcrania test a stem placement
steps.titleZh: 后肢骨骼检验干群位置
steps.text: Eosimias-attributed tali and calcanei preserve a character mosaic used to test stem-anthropoid affinity, but they are isolated from diagnostic teeth.
steps.textZh: 归于 Eosimias 的距骨和跟骨呈现一组性状组合，研究用它们检验其是否接近人猿类干群；这些骨骼与能作诊断的牙齿分离。
steps.annotation: Matrix placement is not direct skeletal association or crown membership.

steps.title: A stem catarrhine is not the split itself
steps.titleZh: 干群狭鼻类不等于分化事件本身
steps.text: SGS-UM 2009-002 preserves catarrhine anatomy and is recovered on the stem in one matrix. Its biochronological age does not directly date the ape–Old World monkey split.
steps.textZh: SGS-UM 2009-002 保存狭鼻类解剖特征，并在一项矩阵中被恢复为干群成员。它的生物年代不能直接给出猿类与旧世界猴分化的时间。
steps.annotation: Specimen anatomy, matrix topology and crown divergence time stay separate.

steps.title: Separate bones support a locomotor model
steps.titleZh: 不同地点的骨骼共同约束运动模型
steps.text: MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 come from different Moroto localities. Shoulder and femoral anatomy constrain a mixed arboreal model, not one skeleton or observed behaviour.
steps.textZh: MUZM 60 和 MUZM 80 来自 Moroto 的不同地点。肩部和股骨形态可用于构建兼有不同运动方式的树栖模型，但它们不是同一具骨架，也没有直接观察到行为。
steps.annotation: The overlying basalt supplies a minimum-age constraint, not a direct specimen date.

steps.title: One skull expands observed variation
steps.titleZh: 一具头骨扩展了已知变异范围
steps.text: D4500 and D2600 form Dmanisi Skull 5 at about 1.8 Ma. It documents one individual and a five-cranium sample, not a final decision that all early Homo names are one lineage.
steps.textZh: D4500 与 D2600 拼合成约 1.8 Ma 的德马尼西 5 号头骨。它记录一个个体，并补充了五个头骨的样本；不能据此最终断定早期人属所有名称都代表同一谱系。
steps.annotation: Taxonomic compression is an interpretation of variation, not part of the skull.

steps.title: A fragment can carry a population model
steps.titleZh: 一块碎骨也可进入群体史模型
steps.text: Vindija 33.19 yielded a high-coverage Neanderthal genome and a >45.5 ka direct result. The roughly 52 ka age and population histories are branch-shortening and demographic models.
steps.textZh: Vindija 33.19 提供高覆盖度尼安德特人基因组，并有大于 45.5 ka 的直接测年结果。约 52 ka 的年龄和群体历史则来自分支长度与人口统计模型。
steps.annotation: Direct radiocarbon bounds and genomic time estimates are not interchangeable.

steps.title: A dated genome bounds contact indirectly
steps.titleZh: 已测年的基因组只能间接限定基因交流
steps.text: Ust’-Ishim 1 is directly dated to 46,880–43,210 cal BP and deposited as PRJEB6622. Neanderthal segment length models earlier admixture but not its exact place or number of episodes.
steps.textZh: Ust’-Ishim 1 的直接测年为 46,880–43,210 cal BP，测序数据存入 PRJEB6622。尼安德特人片段长度模型支持更早发生过混合，但不能给出确切地点或混合次数。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 530 accepted species names to this package; that is naming coverage, not 530 fossil or genome dossiers.

title: Eleven dossiers across carnivoran origins, form and function
titleZh: 横跨食肉类起源、形态与功能的十一个证据档案
dek: Follow named teeth, skulls, skeletons, sequence matrices and digital experiments without converting separate branches into an ancestor ladder.

steps.title: Teeth and ankle bones expand the original sample
steps.titleZh: 牙齿与踝部骨骼扩展了样本
steps.text: IRSNB M2095–M2099 underpin a reconstruction of the permanent dentition. Separate ankle and hindfoot bones include astragali IRSNB M2107–M2108 and heel bone IRSNB M2109.
steps.textZh: IRSNB M2095–M2099 为永久齿列复原提供依据。其他踝部与足部骨骼包括距骨 IRSNB M2107–M2108，以及跟骨 IRSNB M2109。
steps.annotation: Dormaalocyon is recovered as a basal carnivoraform in the published character matrix; it is not demonstrated to be crown Carnivora, a direct ancestor or the global first carnivoramorphan.

steps.title: A character matrix tests the traditional “miacoid” grouping
steps.titleZh: 性状矩阵检验传统的“米阿克兽”归类
steps.text: The study scores 99 cranial and dental characters for 40 sampled taxa. In its preferred trees, traditional “Miacidae” and Viverravidae fall outside crown Carnivora rather than forming two tidy stems within it.
steps.textZh: 研究为 40 个取样类群评估了 99 项头骨和牙齿性状。在首选系统树中，传统的“米阿克兽科”和 Viverravidae 位于冠群食肉目之外，并未在冠群内部形成两个整齐的基干类群。
steps.annotation: This result rejects a convenient feliform–caniform ancestor ladder but remains a sampled morphology topology whose nodes can change with scoring, taxon sampling and analytical assumptions.

steps.title: A cranium and associated bones test Caniformia
steps.titleZh: 头骨及关联骨骼检验犬型类的位置
steps.text: Holotype UCMP 85202 preserves the cranium and teeth. Associated paratypes SDSNH 107446 and SDSNH 107447 add bones from the rest of the skeleton to the study of early Caniformia.
steps.textZh: 正模 UCMP 85202 保存头骨和牙齿。关联副模 SDSNH 107446 与 SDSNH 107447 补充了身体其他部位的骨骼，为研究早期犬型类提供材料。
steps.annotation: Basal-caniform placement is an analytical result and familial assignment remains indeterminate; dietary discriminant scores are comparative-model outputs, not stomach contents or observed hunting.

steps.title: Six gene regions sample living carnivorans
steps.titleZh: 六个基因区段取样现生食肉类
steps.text: The combined sequence matrix contains 6,243 DNA base pairs from TR-i-I, TBG, IRBP, ND2, CYTB and 12S rRNA. It samples 76 living species; the resulting branches depend on those taxa and gene regions.
steps.textZh: 合并后的序列矩阵包含来自 TR-i-I、TBG、IRBP、ND2、CYTB 和 12S rRNA 的 6243 个 DNA 碱基，并取样了 76 个现生种。由此得到的分支关系受取样物种和基因区段影响。
steps.annotation: This is a 2005 sequence topology for sampled living taxa; it neither observes fossil anatomy nor fixes fossil first appearances, divergence dates or COL26.8 accepted names.

steps.title: Texas skull and jaw material is re-examined
steps.titleZh: 重新检查德克萨斯州的头骨与颌骨材料
steps.text: The study CT-reconstructs the Gustafsonia cognita holotype cranium, TMM 40209-200. Angelarctocyon australis is represented by specimen TMM 41850-1 and referred jaw material.
steps.textZh: 研究对 Gustafsonia cognita 正模头骨 TMM 40209-200 进行了 CT 重建。Angelarctocyon australis 则由标本 TMM 41850-1 及归入该种的颌骨材料代表。
steps.annotation: The new genera and basal-amphicyonid positions follow revised scoring and sampled trees; they do not locate an exact geographic origin for beardogs or establish direct ancestry.

steps.title: A digital skull tests simulated biting loads
steps.titleZh: 数字头骨检验模拟咬合载荷
steps.text: The complete young-adult holotype skull B-4071 is tested under simulated canine, p4 and m1 bites, as well as pull-back and head-shaking loads. The 2026 study deposits its meshes and scripts on Zenodo; the force patterns are model results.
steps.textZh: 研究在完整的亚成年后期正模头骨 B-4071 上模拟犬齿、第四前臼齿 p4 和第一臼齿 m1 的咬合，也测试向后拉和摇头载荷。2026 年研究将网格与脚本存入 Zenodo；力的分布是模型结果。
steps.annotation: Stress fields, relative bite forces and behavioural scenarios depend on segmentation, material properties, muscle reconstruction, constraints and normalization; they are experiments on models, not observed feeding.

steps.title: Three dental specimens are compared in the panda-affinity analysis
steps.titleZh: 三件牙齿与颌骨标本用于比较熊猫亲缘
steps.text: The sample includes left upper fourth premolar MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, right upper first molar NV-2-40, and partial mandible IPS 46473 with canine-to-second-molar teeth and an associated fourth premolar. These specimens form the anatomical evidence considered in the panda-affinity analysis.
steps.textZh: 样本包括左上第四前臼齿正模 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42、右上第一臼齿 NV-2-40，以及带有犬齿至第二臼齿并关联第四前臼齿的残缺下颌 IPS 46473。这些标本构成熊猫亲缘分析所考虑的解剖证据。
steps.annotation: Ailuropodine placement and herbivorous tendency derive from a character matrix and dental comparison; neither demonstrates identical giant-panda ecology nor a direct ancestor or secure centre of origin.

steps.title: Three localities locate the sampled fossils
steps.titleZh: 三处地点定位了所取样的化石
