steps.text: The UCMP and SDSNH specimens come from member C of the Santiago Formation in San Diego County. The map marks the study localities; it does not show a continent-wide range.
steps.textZh: UCMP 和 SDSNH 标本来自圣迭戈县 Santiago 组 C 段。地图标出研究中的具名地点，不代表该类群在整片大陆上的分布。
steps.annotation: The displayed interval is a source-bounded occurrence window, not a global first or last appearance.

steps.title: Two matrices resolve different branches
steps.titleZh: 两套矩阵呈现不同的分辨率
steps.text: The 50-taxon analysis leaves some close relationships unresolved. In the Paleogene-only consensus, Lycophocyon falls on the caniform branch outside crown Canoidea; that placement is specific to the sampled analysis.
steps.textZh: 包含 50 个类群的分析未能解析部分近缘关系。仅纳入古近纪类群的共识树则将 Lycophocyon 置于犬型支系、冠群 Canoidea 之外；这一位置针对该分析的取样结果。
steps.annotation: Both results are sampled morphology hypotheses; neither is an ancestor ladder.

steps.title: A classifier estimates diet from living reference species
steps.titleZh: 分类器根据现生参照种估计食性
steps.text: Using six variables and 82 living reference species—46 carnivores, 21 omnivores or hard-object feeders, and 15 insectivores—the classifier assigned the fossil holotype an 83% posterior probability of carnivory. This is a model-based classification, not an observed meal.
steps.textZh: 分类器使用六项变量和 82 个现生参照种，其中包括 46 个食肉种、21 个杂食或硬物取食种，以及 15 个食虫种。它给化石正模的食肉类后验概率为 83%。这是模型分类结果，不是直接观察到的食物。
steps.annotation: This is a comparative dietary prediction, not a fossil stomach-content record.

steps.title: Three dental specimens come from two Spanish basins
steps.titleZh: 三件牙齿标本来自西班牙两个盆地
steps.text: The Nombrevilla 2 basin contains the fourth-premolar holotype and first-molar paratype. The partial mandible and associated fourth premolar come from ACM/C6-Camí.
steps.textZh: 第四前臼齿正模和第一臼齿副模来自 Nombrevilla 2 盆地；残缺下颌及关联的第四前臼齿来自 ACM/C6-Camí。
steps.annotation: These occurrence points do not determine a panda-lineage origin centre or a global genus range.

steps.title: The tree places Kretzoiarctos but leaves branches unresolved
steps.titleZh: 系统树放置了 Kretzoiarctos，但分支仍未解析
steps.text: The combined fossil-and-living matrix places Kretzoiarctos within Ailuropodinae. Its majority-rule bootstrap leaves relationships among several ailuropodine branches unresolved.
steps.textZh: 合并化石与现生类群的矩阵将 Kretzoiarctos 置于 Ailuropodinae 内。多数规则自举树仍未解析若干熊猫亚科分支之间的关系。
steps.annotation: The route compares a published morphology result; it is not a direct-ancestor claim or an ecological equivalence with living giant pandas.

steps.title: The teeth and jaw remain separate specimen records
steps.titleZh: 牙齿和颌骨仍是不同的标本记录
steps.text: Figure 1 shows the left fourth premolar NV-2-42, right first molar NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473. The route begins with these preserved specimens before considering dietary interpretations.
steps.textZh: 图 1 展示左上第四前臼齿 NV-2-42、右上第一臼齿 NV-2-40，以及残缺下颌 IPS 46473。这个路线先比较实际保存的标本，再讨论食性解释。
steps.annotation: Dental comparisons can inform a hypothesis, but do not observe feeding or establish giant-panda-equivalent ecology.

steps.title: Simulated loads compare skull mechanics, not behaviour
steps.titleZh: 模拟载荷比较头骨力学，不是行为
steps.text: Finite-element analysis compares canine, p4 and m1 bite positions with standardized external loads. The reported stress and force patterns are simulated results under the study's stated constraints.
steps.textZh: 有限元分析比较犬齿、p4 和 m1 咬合位置，以及标准化外部载荷。报告中的应力和力分布是在研究所述约束下模拟得到的结果。
steps.annotation: The zero time range is the 2026 modelling event, not Magericyon's fossil occurrence; muscle reconstruction and loading choices condition the results.

steps.title: A Tibetan skull and fragments enter the combined sample
steps.titleZh: 西藏头骨与碎片进入合并样本
steps.text: Adult partial cranium IVPP V18788.1 is the holotype; IVPP V18788.2 is a jaw-ramus fragment and IVPP V18788.3 a partial premaxilla. The original magnetostratigraphic framework places the locality sample between 5.95 and 4.10 Ma.
steps.textZh: 成年个体的残缺头骨 IVPP V18788.1 是正模；IVPP V18788.2 为下颌支碎片，IVPP V18788.3 为部分前颌骨。原始磁性地层框架将地点样本置于 595 万至 410 万年前。
steps.annotation: The original Panthera assignment, snow-leopard affinity and Asian biogeographic scenario are analytical conclusions that later work may revise; the sample is not a universal pantherine FAD.

steps.title: Inner-ear shape is compared with inferred locomotion
steps.titleZh: 用内耳形态比较推断的运动方式
steps.text: The 36-specimen sample includes Field Museum skulls of Hesperocyon gregarius and Aelurodon. Researchers segmented the left inner-ear bony labyrinths and compared their shapes with PCA, CVA and MANOVA; these analyses test functional patterns rather than preserve a hunt.
steps.textZh: 36 件标本样本包括菲尔德自然史博物馆收藏的 Hesperocyon gregarius 和 Aelurodon 头骨。研究者分割左侧骨迷路并用 PCA、CVA 和 MANOVA 比较形状；这些分析检验功能模式，并未保存动物狩猎的过程。
steps.annotation: The reported 82.05% classification and pounce assignment are proxy-model results conditioned on living categories, scaling and phylogeny; they do not preserve an actual hunt or social behaviour.

steps.title: A lake-deposit skeleton preserves much of the body
steps.titleZh: 湖相地层中的骨架保存了大部分身体
steps.text: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves about 65% of a skeleton, including skull, teeth, vertebrae, and substantial fore- and hind limbs. It comes from an early Miocene lake deposit; the setting alone does not establish how the animal lived.
steps.textZh: 正模 NUFV 405 保存了约 65% 的骨架，包括头骨、牙齿、椎骨以及较完整的前后肢。它出自早中新世湖相沉积；沉积环境本身不能说明动物如何生活。
steps.annotation: Semi-aquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph position and an Arctic freshwater transition are morphology, topology and palaeoenvironmental interpretations; Puijila is not demonstrated as a direct pinniped ancestor.

steps.title: A stem-pinniped skeleton supplies limbs for comparison
steps.titleZh: 海豹祖先支系骨架提供肢体比较材料
steps.text: LACM 4321 preserves a skull and much of the rest of the skeleton. Its limb proportions and joint shapes can be compared with living pinnipeds and land-dwelling carnivorans; comparison does not directly record its swimming behaviour.
steps.textZh: LACM 4321 保存头骨及大部分身体骨骼。其肢体比例和关节形态可与现生鳍足类和陆生食肉类比较，但比较不能直接记录它如何游泳。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 310 accepted living species names through Carnivora. This is nomenclatural coverage, not eleven ancestor stages, 310 mature dossiers, a fossil FAD, or agreement among topology and clock models.

title: Twelve mammal dossiers, not an ancestor ladder
titleZh: 十二份哺乳类证据档案，而非祖先阶梯
dek: These twelve cases compare fossils, a genome draft, bone-density measurements, and evolutionary trees. Each records a different sample or analysis; together they do not form a single sequence of direct ancestors.
summaryZh: 这十二个案例比较化石、基因组草图、骨密度测量与系统树。每项研究记录不同的样本或分析，合在一起也不构成一条直接祖先序列。

steps.title: Three molars in a Steropodon jaw
steps.text: AM F66763 is a fragment of the right lower jaw with three molars. Their shapes were compared with monotreme and tribosphenic dental patterns; the fragment supplies a focused dental sample, not a complete skull or skeleton.
steps.titleZh: Steropodon 下颌中的三颗臼齿
steps.textZh: AM F66763 是一段右下颌骨，保存三颗臼齿。研究者将牙齿形态与单孔类及兽齿型牙列作比较；这是一份聚焦牙齿的样本，不是完整头骨或骨架。
steps.annotation: Dental homology and affinity are interpretations; one jaw cannot establish a direct ancestor, a complete body plan or an immutable global first occurrence.

steps.title: A draft genome for the platypus
steps.text: The genome project assembled about 26.9 million reads into a 1.84-gigabase draft at roughly sixfold coverage. It ordered 437 megabases on 20 chromosomes and predicted 18,527 protein-coding genes. These are properties of the draft assembly, not a complete sequence.
steps.titleZh: 鸭嘴兽的基因组草图
steps.textZh: 该基因组项目将约 2,690 万条序列读段组装成 1.84 Gb 草图，覆盖度约六倍；其中 4.37 亿碱基被排列到 20 条染色体上，并预测了 18,527 个蛋白质编码基因。这些数字描述草图组装，不代表完整序列。
steps.annotation: Assembly gaps, one-individual sampling, annotation and comparative models prevent direct reconstruction of an ancestral genome or single-gene explanations for organismal traits.

steps.title: Eomaia: skeleton and tree placement
steps.text: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b preserves the skull, teeth, and much of the postcranial skeleton. In the original study, the character matrix and limb comparisons placed Eomaia near the base of Eutheria and supported a scansorial, or climbing, interpretation.
steps.titleZh: Eomaia：骨架与树上的位置
steps.textZh: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 保存头骨、牙齿和大部分头后骨骼。原研究的特征矩阵与四肢比较将 Eomaia 放在真兽类基部附近，并支持其具有攀爬型解释。
steps.annotation: Later combined matrices can move Eomaia outside Theria; topology and scansoriality are analytical outputs, not a directly observed ancestor or behaviour.

steps.title: Juramaia and a conditional Jurassic signal
steps.text: BMNH PM1343B preserves skull, teeth, and postcranial bones. The original study associated it with strata about 160 million years old and recovered it near the base of Eutheria; both the age signal and placement belong to that study's evidence and analysis.
steps.titleZh: Juramaia 与有条件的侏罗纪信号
steps.textZh: BMNH PM1343B 保存头骨、牙齿和头后骨骼。原研究将它与约 1.6 亿年前的地层联系起来，并在分析中恢复为靠近真兽类基部的位置；年代线索和系统位置都属于该研究的证据与分析。
steps.annotation: Commercial collection provenance, stratigraphic attribution and matrices condition the result; unconstrained tip dating yields a younger morphological age signal rather than directly redating the rock.

steps.title: Ear and hyoid bones in Ambolestes
steps.text: STM33-5 preserves the ectotympanic, malleus, and hyoid bones. The published character matrix placed Ambolestes and Sinodelphys within Eutheria, a result tied to that matrix and its sampled characters.
steps.titleZh: Ambolestes 的耳骨与舌骨
steps.textZh: STM33-5 保存鼓环骨、锤骨和舌骨。已发表的特征矩阵将 Ambolestes 与 Sinodelphys 置于真兽类之中；结果取决于该矩阵及其中纳入的性状。
steps.annotation: Reassignment and the resulting metatherian ghost lineage depend on sampled characters and taxa; the analysis does not observe the placental–marsupial split.

steps.title: A placental matrix paired with genes
steps.text: One study scored 4,541 phenomic characters for 86 living and fossil species, using more than 12,000 annotated images, and combined the matrix with 27 nuclear genes. The result depends on this combined morphological and genetic sample.
steps.titleZh: 与基因数据结合的胎盘类矩阵
steps.textZh: 一项研究为 86 种现生与化石物种编码 4,541 个表型特征，使用了超过 12,000 张带注释图像，并将矩阵与 27 个核基因合并分析。结果取决于这组形态和遗传样本。
steps.annotation: The post-K–Pg chronology and reconstructed phenotype depend on parsimony, fossil ages, ghost lineages and ancestral-state optimization; no ancestor was directly observed.

steps.title: Four clades in a placental gene tree
steps.text: A 16,397-base-pair dataset combined 19 nuclear genes with three mitochondrial genes. Bayesian and maximum-likelihood analyses recovered four major placental clades in the sampled tree.
steps.titleZh: 胎盘类基因树中的四大支系
steps.textZh: 一个含 16,397 个碱基对的数据集结合了 19 个核基因与 3 个线粒体基因。贝叶斯分析和最大似然分析在所采样树中恢复出四个主要胎盘类支系。
steps.annotation: The Afrotheria root, dates and Gondwanan scenario are model-conditioned, later studies test alternatives, and sampled taxa from other packages remain cross-boundary inputs.

steps.title: Eritherium: a growing anatomical sample
steps.text: The Eritherium holotype, MNHN PM69, preserves a rostrum and upper-jaw teeth. Fourteen additional specimens extend the sampled upper and lower dentition and skull anatomy beyond the holotype.
steps.titleZh: Eritherium：扩展中的解剖样本
steps.textZh: Eritherium 正模 MNHN PM69 保存吻部和上颌牙齿。另有 14 件标本扩展了研究纳入的上下颌牙列与头骨解剖信息。
steps.annotation: Stem placement and estimated 3–8 kilogram body mass derive from a character matrix and dental allometry, not observed ancestry or body mass.

steps.title: Bone compactness across Thalassocnus
steps.text: CT slices and thin sections show increasing bone compactness across ribs and limb bones in the sampled Thalassocnus series. The comparison includes named T. littoralis specimens MNHN.F.SAS 2 and MNHN.F.SAS 53; it tracks skeletal density, not behavior directly.
steps.titleZh: Thalassocnus 的骨骼致密度
steps.textZh: CT 切片和薄片显示，所采样的 Thalassocnus 系列中，肋骨和四肢骨的致密度逐渐增加。比较包括具名的 T. littoralis 标本 MNHN.F.SAS 2 与 MNHN.F.SAS 53；它反映骨骼致密度，不是直接观察到的行为。
steps.annotation: Aquatic adaptation, hydrostatic control and marine grazing are functional interpretations; species succession is not a directly observed ancestor chain.

steps.title: Mimolagus teeth and ankle bones
steps.text: The right third upper molar of holotype IVPP V20115, together with referred teeth, an astragalus, calcanei, and a cuboid, defines the anatomical sample and locality used in the study. These elements come from more than one referred specimen.
steps.titleZh: Mimolagus 的牙齿与踝骨
steps.textZh: 正模 IVPP V20115 的右上第三臼齿，以及归入的牙齿、距骨、跟骨和骰骨，共同界定研究使用的解剖样本与产地。这些骨骼来自不止一件归入标本。
steps.annotation: A 4.5-kilogram estimate, cursoriality and tapiroid-like niche are regression and ecomorphology inferences; the taxon is not a direct lagomorph ancestor.

steps.title: Wing and cochlea comparisons in Onychonycteris
steps.text: ROM 55351A preserves elongated wings and a relatively small cochlea. Researchers compared limb proportions and cochlear size with living and fossil bats; these anatomical proxies do not directly record how an individual flew or sensed sound.
steps.titleZh: Onychonycteris 的翼与耳蜗比较
steps.textZh: ROM 55351A 保存修长的翼骨，耳蜗相对较小。研究者将四肢比例与耳蜗尺寸同现生和化石蝙蝠比较；这些解剖指标不是对单只动物飞行或听觉方式的直接记录。
steps.annotation: Powered flight and absence of specialized laryngeal echolocation are functional inferences, not observed behaviour, and one specimen is not a direct ancestor.

steps.title: A seven-gene bat topology
steps.text: Four nuclear and three mitochondrial genes contributed 8,230 aligned base pairs. In the study's analyses, sampled rhinolophoids grouped with megabats rather than with the other sampled microbats; this is a result of those datasets and methods.
steps.titleZh: 七基因蝙蝠系统树
steps.textZh: 四个核基因和三个线粒体基因共提供 8,230 个比对碱基对。在该研究的分析中，采样到的菊头蝠类与狐蝠类聚在一起，而没有与其他采样的微型蝙蝠聚类；这是该数据集与方法所得的结果。
steps.annotation: Multiple origins or losses of laryngeal echolocation are alternative historical reconstructions; the topology does not directly observe the first flight or sonar event. COL26.8 routes 5,099 accepted living species to other-mammals after excluding Cetartiodactyla, Perissodactyla, Primates and Carnivora; that nomenclatural snapshot is not 5,099 dossiers and does not resolve fossil topology.

title: Twelve dinosaur evidence sets without an ancestor ladder
titleZh: 十二组恐龙证据，不是一架祖先阶梯
dek: Compare named fossils, anatomical matrices, growth evidence, traces and mechanical models. Each supports a different kind of conclusion; together they do not make a simple ladder of direct ancestors.

steps.title: Two matrices test different dinosaur roots
steps.text: Baron et al. analysed 457 characters and recovered Ornithoscelida. Langer et al. added taxa and rescored characters, recovering the traditional split instead. These are competing tests of character patterns, not observations of a branching event.
steps.annotation: The 233–228 Ma atlas interval is a display context for early dinosaur fossils, not an age inferred by either morphology matrix.
steps.titleZh: 不同矩阵检验不同的恐龙根部关系
steps.textZh: Baron 等人分析 457 项性状并恢复了将鸟臀类与兽脚类合为一支的 Ornithoscelida 假说。Langer 等人加入分类单元并重评性状后，恢复传统分支。这些是对性状模式的不同检验，不是直接观察到分支事件。

steps.title: Teeth inform an ancestral-diet model
steps.text: ULBRA-PVT280 preserves recurved, serrated teeth. A model places faunivory—feeding on animals—near the sauropodomorph root. The teeth are direct evidence; the ancestral diet is a reconstruction, not a feeding ancestor found in the rock.
steps.annotation: Formation correlation bounds the age; the dietary transition is a mapped hypothesis across sampled taxa, not a linear sequence observed in one lineage.
steps.titleZh: 牙齿进入祖先食性模型
steps.textZh: ULBRA-PVT280 保存了向后弯曲的锯齿状牙齿。一个模型把动物食性放在蜥脚形类根部附近。牙齿是直接证据；祖先食性是模型重建，不是直接发现的祖先进食证据。

steps.title: A partial skeleton does not set a global first
steps.text: SAM-PK-K8025 is a partial skeleton that informs an early ornithischian branch. Its matrix placement and the age of its formation constrain this specimen’s context, but do not establish the group’s first appearance worldwide.
steps.annotation: The broad display interval follows formation-level correlation and must not be read as a direct specimen date or a global ornithischian FAD.
steps.titleZh: 部分骨架不能确定全球首次出现
steps.textZh: SAM-PK-K8025 是一具残缺骨架，为早期鸟臀类分支提供信息。矩阵位置和地层年龄限定了这件标本的背景，却不能确定该类群在全球的首次出现。

steps.title: One species changes stance as it grows
steps.text: Digital models of Mussaurus combine specimens at several growth stages. They support a shift from bipedal to quadrupedal posture during growth in this species; the modelled change is not an evolutionary sequence between species.
steps.annotation: The fossils constrain anatomy; centre of mass and stance are sensitivity-tested reconstructions and cannot be generalized to every sauropodomorph.
steps.titleZh: 一个物种在成长中改变姿势
steps.textZh: Mussaurus 的数字模型综合不同生长阶段的多件标本。模型支持这个物种在成长中由双足转向四足姿势；它不是物种之间的演化序列。

steps.title: A giant with flexed limbs
steps.text: BP/1/7120 supports an adult giant whose limbs were flexed. The estimate of about twelve tonnes and the interpretation of habitual quadrupedality come from comparisons with a partial skeleton, not a direct measurement of a complete animal.
steps.annotation: The specimen is incomplete and the earliest-Jurassic interval is formation-bounded; it is not a universal threshold or ancestor for sauropod gigantism.
steps.titleZh: 肢体弯曲的巨型个体
steps.textZh: BP/1/7120 支持一只成体巨型恐龙，其肢体处于屈曲姿势。约 12 吨的估值和习惯性四足姿势解释来自与残缺骨架的比较，而不是对完整动物直接测量。

steps.title: Preserved armour and inferred covering
steps.text: NHMUK R1111 preserves associated osteoderms, the bony plates in the skin. Some armour is missing and a keratin covering is inferred. Its position on the ankylosaur stem comes from character analysis, separate from what the specimen preserves.
steps.annotation: Missing armour and preparation history prevent a complete in-place map; placement is one analysis rather than an uncontested thyreophoran topology.
steps.titleZh: 保存的甲片与推断的覆盖物
steps.textZh: NHMUK R1111 保存伴生的皮内骨，即皮肤中的骨板。有些甲片缺失，角质覆盖是推断结果。它在甲龙干群中的位置来自性状分析，与标本直接保存的内容不同。

steps.title: A complete skeleton tests a character combination
steps.text: IVPP V14530 preserves a nearly complete early ceratopsian skeleton. Its proposed place in the dinosaur tree is the result of a character-matrix analysis, not evidence that it was a direct ancestor of later horned dinosaurs.
steps.annotation: The atlas interval is formation-level; topology and character polarity depend on outgroups, coding and the sampled matrix.
steps.titleZh: 完整骨架检验一组性状
steps.textZh: IVPP V14530 保存了一具近乎完整的早期角龙类骨架。它在恐龙树中的位置来自性状矩阵分析，并不表示它是后期有角恐龙的直接祖先。

steps.title: Skin and feeding marks constrain one carcass story
steps.text: NDGS 2000 preserves skin impressions and traces interpreted as feeding marks. The authors propose that scavenging helped desiccate this carcass. That taphonomic pathway explains one fossil’s preservation; it is not a general rule for dinosaur carcasses.
steps.annotation: The evidence concerns one specimen and one depositional history; skin presence does not establish original colour, physiology or preservation frequency.
steps.titleZh: 皮肤和取食痕限定一具尸体的保存过程
steps.textZh: NDGS 2000 保存了皮肤印痕和被解释为取食痕的痕迹化石。作者提出食腐可能使这具尸体脱水保存。这种埋藏过程解释一件化石，不是恐龙尸体保存的一般规律。

steps.title: Filaments do not settle flight or function
steps.text: Three Yutyrannus skeletons preserve filamentous integument. The fossils document those structures, but not their original function, full-body coverage or a flight capability. Those questions are separate from the animal’s placement relative to birds.
steps.annotation: Non-avian integument stays here; Avialae, flight models and living-bird COL26.8 names remain owned by crocodylomorphs-birds.
steps.titleZh: 丝状体被不能确定飞行或功能
steps.textZh: 三具 Yutyrannus 骨架保存了丝状体被。化石记录了这些结构，却没有确定其原始功能、全身体被范围或飞行能力；这些问题也不同于其相对鸟类的系统位置。

steps.title: A pose supports, but does not show, brooding
steps.text: IGM 100/979 lies over a clutch in a bird-like posture. The association strongly supports a brooding interpretation, but behaviour is inferred from the fossil position rather than directly observed.
steps.annotation: The original paper explicitly retains alternative explanations and limits testing of parental-system hypotheses in the fossil record.
steps.titleZh: 姿势支持抱卵解释，却不是行为的直接记录
steps.textZh: IGM 100/979 位于一窝卵之上，呈鸟类样姿势。这种关联有力支持抱卵解释，但行为是根据化石姿势推断出来的，并非直接观察。

steps.title: Growth marks feed a fitted model
steps.text: Growth marks in tyrannosaurid bones are observations. The ages and masses assigned to individuals, and the fitted logistic growth rates, are outputs of a model built from those marks.
steps.annotation: The 83–66 Ma atlas window spans sampled tyrannosaurids, not one population; the fitted curve is not a universal dinosaur growth schedule.
steps.titleZh: 生长标记进入拟合模型
steps.textZh: 暴龙科骨骼中的生长标记是观察结果。赋予个体的年龄和体重，以及拟合出的逻辑斯蒂生长率，都是基于这些标记建立的模型输出。

steps.title: Traces show bone consumption; models estimate force
steps.text: MOR 799 trace fossils and a coprolite—a fossilized dropping—containing bone support osteophagy, or bone eating. Bite force and pressure estimates come from a biomechanical model of seven skulls; they are not direct measurements of every tyrannosaur.
steps.annotation: The models test capability rather than observe a feeding event; MOR 799 and the coprolite do not identify every individual or every feeding context.
steps.titleZh: 遗迹显示食骨，模型估计作用力
steps.textZh: MOR 799 的遗迹化石和含骨粪化石支持食骨行为。咬合力与压力估计来自对七个头骨进行的生物力学模型，并非对每只暴龙直接测量。

dekZh: 比较具名化石、解剖矩阵、生长证据、遗迹和力学模型。每类材料支持不同结论；它们合起来也不构成直接祖先的简单阶梯。

title: Fourteen sponge and cnidarian dossiers without a first-animal ladder
titleZh: 不构成“第一动物”阶梯的十四个海绵与刺胞动物档案
dek: Move from contested Cryogenian molecules through named Ediacaran and Cambrian fossils to living genomes, coral clocks and ecological proxies while keeping compounds, specimens, topology, model time and COL26.8 names distinct.
dekZh: 从有争议的冷冻纪分子信号，走到埃迪卡拉纪和寒武纪具名化石，再到现生基因组、珊瑚分子钟与生态代理指标；把化合物、标本、亲缘拓扑、模型年代和 COL26.8 名称区分开来。

steps.title: A molecule is not a unique animal
steps.titleZh: 一种分子并非某种动物的专属标记
steps.text: The Oman steranes are real measurements, but Rhizaria make relevant precursors. The package records a contested source attribution rather than a Cryogenian sponge fossil.
steps.textZh: 阿曼甾烷是实际测得的化合物，但根足类也能产生相关前体。资料记录的是对来源的争论，不是一块冷冻纪海绵化石。
steps.annotation: Chemical occurrence and taxonomic diagnosis stay separate.

steps.title: One cellular fossil stays one sample
steps.titleZh: 一件细胞化石仍只是一份样本
steps.text: Eocyathispongia preserves striking cellular organization, but the dossier does not turn funnel-like openings into a secure crown-sponge diagnosis.
steps.textZh: Eocyathispongia 保存了醒目的细胞组织，但档案没有把漏斗状开口直接当作可靠的冠群海绵诊断。
steps.annotation: Imaged anatomy is firmer than affinity.

steps.title: An organic lattice tests a crown hypothesis
steps.titleZh: 有机网格检验冠群假说
steps.text: Helicolocellus combines repeated body-wall grids with a morphology-matrix placement. Architecture is observed; hexactinellid affinity is inferred.
steps.textZh: Helicolocellus 显示重复排列的体壁网格，并通过形态矩阵测试其位置。网格结构是观察结果；与六放海绵的亲缘关系仍是推断。
steps.annotation: Organic skeleton and siliceous spicule are not synonyms.

steps.title: Diagnostic criteria move the boundary
steps.titleZh: 诊断标准会移动化石边界
steps.text: The Soltanieh spicules survive a candidate-by-candidate reassessment, while older claims fail different taphonomic or diagnostic tests.
steps.textZh: 对 Soltanieh 海绵骨针逐件复核后，部分候选记录仍站得住；更早的主张则分别未通过埋藏学或诊断特征检验。
steps.annotation: A review boundary is revisable, not eternal.

steps.title: A toolkit is not a body plan
steps.titleZh: 基因工具箱不等于动物身体蓝图
steps.text: Amphimedon retains extensive animal gene machinery. Comparative presence does not mean a sponge expresses bilaterian organs or mirrors the first animal.
steps.textZh: Amphimedon 保留了大量动物基因机制。基因在海绵中存在，不代表海绵会表达两侧对称动物的器官，也不意味着它能代表第一种动物。
steps.annotation: Genome content and phenotype remain distinct evidence.

steps.title: The root depends on the model
steps.titleZh: 动物树根部取决于模型
steps.text: Porifera-sister and Ctenophora-sister each have genome-scale support. The atlas exposes the conflict instead of selecting a silent consensus.
steps.textZh: 基因组规模的分析分别支持“海绵先分支”和“栉水母先分支”两种根部位置。图谱保留这场冲突，没有悄悄指定一个共识答案。
steps.annotation: Support values are conditional, not votes from nature.

steps.title: A branching polyp precedes the Cambrian
steps.titleZh: 分枝状水螅体把线索带到寒武纪以前
steps.text: Auroralumina supplies a crown-cnidarian hypothesis from a dated surface, while preserved anatomy and phylogenetic placement remain separate.
steps.textZh: Auroralumina 来自有年代约束的岩面，为冠群刺胞动物假说提供线索；化石保存的解剖结构与系统发育位置仍是两类证据。
steps.annotation: One surface can test, not settle, a crown.

steps.title: A fibre-like impression is not histology
steps.titleZh: 纤维状印痕并非组织切片
steps.text: At approximately 560 Ma, Haootia shows ordered linear structures. Muscle and staurozoan readings remain explicit hypotheses with supporting and opposing studies.
steps.textZh: 约 560 Ma 的 Haootia 显示有序排列的线状结构。把它们解释为肌肉或钵水母类相关结构，仍是有支持与反对研究的假说。
steps.annotation: Visible pattern and tissue identity are different claims.

steps.title: More specimens can assemble a different animal
steps.titleZh: 更多标本可能拼出不同的动物
steps.text: Ou et al. recover a stem-cnidarian body plan, whereas Zhao et al. recover Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem; alternative coding leaves a polytomy.
steps.textZh: Ou 等人将材料恢复为干群刺胞动物体制；Zhao 等人则把 Dinomischidae 放在栉水母干群。改变性状编码后，部分分支无法分开，结果成为多分叉。
steps.annotation: Synonymy, anatomy and topology each need evidence.

steps.title: A bell and tentacles constrain a medusa
steps.titleZh: 钟形体与触手约束水母形态
steps.text: Burgessomedusa supplies macroscopic medusa anatomy by the middle Cambrian. It is a bounded fossil sample, not the origin event itself.
steps.textZh: Burgessomedusa 在寒武纪中期留下可见的大型水母体解剖结构。这是有明确样本边界的化石，不是水母起源发生的那一刻。
steps.annotation: Minimum evidence is not a complete history.

steps.title: One quarry, not a global range
steps.titleZh: 一个采石场不等于全球分布
steps.text: The map fixes Burgessomedusa to Raymond Quarry in British Columbia. It does not turn a single Burgess Shale sample into a worldwide distribution.
steps.textZh: 地图把 Burgessomedusa 的记录定位在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的 Raymond Quarry。单一伯吉斯页岩样本不能代表全球分布。
steps.annotation: A site age is not a FAD or LAD.

steps.title: A box-like bell tests, not settles, placement
steps.titleZh: 箱形钟体能检验分类，却不能定论
steps.text: Burgessomedusa has a cuboidal umbrella and more than ninety marginal tentacles. Comparison with living medusozoans is informative, but compression and coding sensitivity retain several placements.
steps.textZh: Burgessomedusa 有近方箱形伞部和九十多条边缘触手。与现生水母类比较很有帮助，但压扁变形和性状编码敏感性仍让它有多个可能位置。
steps.annotation: Morphospace comparison is not a direct ancestor line.

steps.title: A living reef sample has no fossil duration
steps.titleZh: 现生珊瑚礁样本没有化石延限
steps.text: Amphimedon queenslandica was sampled from the Great Barrier Reef. The route maps the living sample and deliberately carries no numerical species fossil range.
steps.textZh: Amphimedon queenslandica 的样本来自大堡礁。此路线标记现生样本，不附加数值化的物种化石延限。
steps.annotation: Living occurrence does not date species origin.

steps.title: One genome, three figured life stages
steps.titleZh: 一套基因组配三幅生活史图
steps.text: The study figures adult, embryo and larval stages alongside a draft genome. Sequence content and life stages are observations; an ancestral body plan is not.
steps.textZh: 研究同时展示成体、胚胎、幼体和一套草图基因组。序列内容与生活史阶段是研究对象；它们没有直接保存祖先动物的身体蓝图。
steps.annotation: Observed life history is not a Precambrian reconstruction.

steps.title: A toolkit is not an ancestor
steps.titleZh: 基因工具箱不是祖先本人
steps.text: Comparative gene-family results document a living demosponge genome and test deep animal relationships. They do not make Amphimedon a stand-in for all Porifera or the first animal.
steps.textZh: 基因家族比较记录了现生寻常海绵的基因组，并用于检验动物深层亲缘关系。它不能让 Amphimedon 代表所有海绵，更不能把它当作第一种动物。
steps.annotation: Comparative ancestry remains an inference.

steps.title: Some deep nodes resolve, one stays weak
steps.titleZh: 深层分支有的清楚，有的仍不稳
steps.text: The sampled matrix supports Anthozoa and Medusozoa and several internal groups, but Ceriantharia keeps Hexacorallia uncertain.
steps.textZh: 受采样的矩阵支持珊瑚纲、钵水母纲和若干内部类群；但花筒珊瑚的结果使六放珊瑚类内部位置仍不确定。
steps.annotation: A supported subset is not a universal tree.

steps.title: Extreme reduction does not erase ancestry
steps.titleZh: 身体极度缩减不会抹去亲缘历史
steps.text: Myxozoan genomes place microscopic parasites inside Cnidaria. Their reduced bodies do not represent the ancestral cnidarian condition.
steps.textZh: 黏孢子虫基因组把这些微小寄生生物放在刺胞动物内部。它们极度简化的身体不代表刺胞动物祖先的形态。
steps.annotation: Secondary loss must not be read as primitiveness.

steps.title: A clock can precede a skeleton
steps.titleZh: 分子钟可以早于可见骨骼记录
steps.text: Deep-water coral genes support an older split than the familiar Triassic skeleton record. Model time and fossil time stay separate.
steps.textZh: 深海珊瑚的基因数据支持一个比熟知的三叠纪骨骼记录更早的分支时间。模型给出的年代与化石年代仍要分开。
steps.annotation: A posterior interval is not a hidden fossil.

steps.title: Skeleton chemistry records an ecological model
steps.titleZh: 骨骼化学记录生态模型的信号
steps.text: Late-Triassic corals carry several proxy signals consistent with photosymbiosis. The symbiont is inferred, not fossilized.
steps.textZh: 晚三叠世珊瑚骨骼包含多种代理信号，与光合共生相符。共生者本身没有作为化石保存；这是由化学证据推断的生态关系。
steps.annotation: Proxy agreement strengthens but does not become direct observation.

title: Thirteen evidence cases on mollusc and brachiopod body plans
titleZh: 软体动物与腕足动物体制的十三个证据案例
dek: Follow fossils, experiments and genomes while keeping observed structures, proposed homologies, evolutionary trees and scientific names distinct.

steps.title: A fossil outline is mollusc-like, but not a crown diagnosis
steps.titleZh: 化石轮廓类似软体动物，却不足以归入现生冠群
steps.text: More than 35 White Sea specimens preserve bilateral organization and a dorsal cover. They lack a radula and the diagnostic combination used to identify crown molluscs, so the fossils support a body-plan comparison without fixing their position among living molluscs.
steps.textZh: 白海地区三十五件以上标本保存了两侧对称结构和背部覆盖物，却没有齿舌，也不具备识别现生软体动物冠群所需的诊断性状组合。因此，这些化石可用于比较体制，但尚不能确定它们在现生软体动物谱系中的位置。
steps.annotation: A named Ediacaran sample tests character homology without becoming a direct ancestor or global Mollusca first appearance.

steps.title: Repeated tooth rows make a radula hypothesis testable
steps.titleZh: 重复齿列让齿舌假说可以检验
steps.text: Across 189 Odontogriphus specimens, paired teeth sit on a membrane and are replaced toward the rear beside a broad foot and mantle groove. A radula is a toothed feeding ribbon in living molluscs; the repeated arrangement offers a specific feature to test against that interpretation.
steps.textZh: 在 189 件 Odontogriphus 标本中，成对牙齿排列在一层膜上，并向后替换；化石旁还保存宽阔的足和外套沟。齿舌是现生软体动物的带齿摄食结构，这种重复排列为检验该解释提供了具体特征。
steps.annotation: The geometry is observed; radular homology and stem-mollusc placement remain comparative conclusions.

steps.title: One articulated body carries shell and sclerites
steps.titleZh: 一具相连身体上同时保存壳与骨片
steps.text: Orthrozanclus combines an anterior shell with three zones of overlapping sclerites, small hard plates, and long marginal spines. Their arrangement on one articulated fossil is direct evidence; how the parts relate to other molluscan shell structures is a separate homology question.
steps.textZh: Orthrozanclus 同时保存前部壳片、三列相互叠覆的小型硬质骨片，以及边缘长刺。它们在同一具相连化石上的排列是直接观察；这些结构与其他软体动物壳体是否同源，则是另一项比较问题。
steps.annotation: Halwaxiida is a scored topology, not an observed ancestor chain or secure crown assignment.

steps.title: Shell layers are not all nacre
steps.titleZh: 壳层结构并不都等同于珍珠层
steps.text: Pojetaia shell sections preserve a layered inner fabric, compared in the study with foliated aragonite. The evidence does not establish undisputed nacre in Cambrian molluscs, so the shell microstructure should not be assigned a familiar material name without qualification.
steps.textZh: Pojetaia 的壳体切片保存了层状内层结构，研究将其与片状霰石进行比较。现有证据尚未确立寒武纪软体动物中无争议的珍珠层，因此不应不加限定地把这种微观结构等同于熟悉的壳层材料。
steps.annotation: Preservation and homology limit mineral interpretation; the sections do not establish every bivalve shell pathway.

steps.title: Nectocaris keeps a cephalopod hypothesis open
steps.titleZh: Nectocaris 让头足类归属继续接受检验
steps.text: Ninety newly prepared specimens show paired eyes, fins, two tentacles and a funnel-like structure. The combination makes the proposed cephalopod connection testable, but these structures alone do not settle how Nectocaris belongs in the molluscan tree.
steps.textZh: 九十件新制备的 Nectocaris 标本显示成对眼睛、鳍、两条触腕和漏斗状结构。这组特征使头足类联系假说可以检验，但仅凭它们仍不能确定 Nectocaris 在软体动物系统树上的位置。
steps.annotation: Missing shell, siphuncle, beak and radula evidence keeps the cephalopod placement explicitly contested.

steps.title: One phylogenomic matrix recovers Aculifera
steps.titleZh: 一套系统基因组矩阵支持多板类群
steps.text: In the Kocot et al. analyses, chitons group with sampled aplacophorans, while gastropods and bivalves form another supported clade. This is a result from one phylogenomic matrix—an analysis combining many genetic markers—not a final answer independent of taxon sampling and method.
steps.textZh: 在 Kocot 等人的分析中，石鳖与纳入研究的无板类聚为一支，腹足类与双壳类则形成另一受支持的支系。这是一个系统基因组矩阵——结合多种遗传标记进行分析——所得的结果，并非不受类群取样和方法影响的最终答案。
steps.annotation: Monoplacophora was absent and some alternatives were not rejected, so the result remains matrix-specific.

steps.title: New transcriptomes bring Monoplacophora into the comparison
steps.titleZh: 新增转录组把单板类纳入比较
steps.text: Fifteen new transcriptomes expanded the sample to include every major living molluscan class. In the principal analyses, Monoplacophora groups with Cephalopoda; this placement belongs to that sampled matrix and its methods.
steps.textZh: 新增的十五份转录组扩大了取样范围，使现生软体动物各主要纲都进入比较。在主要分析中，单板类与头足类聚为一支；这一位置属于该矩阵的取样和分析方法。
steps.annotation: Conflicting deep nodes and corrected supplementary figures are retained rather than averaged into false certainty.

steps.title: Embryos connect Nodal signaling with shell chirality
steps.titleZh: 胚胎实验检验 Nodal 信号与壳旋向的联系
steps.text: In Lottia and Biomphalaria embryos, Nodal and Pitx expression occurs on opposite sides. Inhibition disrupts the pathway output and shell coiling, linking developmental signaling to chirality without making the two species’ shell forms identical.
steps.textZh: 在 Lottia 与 Biomphalaria 胚胎中，Nodal 和 Pitx 的表达位于相反两侧。抑制实验会扰乱信号通路输出和壳体旋向，说明发育信号与左右不对称有关，但不表示这两个物种的壳形完全相同。
steps.annotation: This living experiment does not directly reconstruct fossil torsion or every gastropod coiling mechanism.

steps.title: An octopus genome reveals routes to novelty
steps.titleZh: 章鱼基因组显示新性状可由多种变化形成
steps.text: One Octopus bimaculoides genome and transcriptomes from twelve tissues reveal targeted gene-family expansions and extensive rearrangement across the genome. These findings show genomic change in the sampled animal; they do not reduce cephalopod novelty to one mechanism.
steps.textZh: 一份 Octopus bimaculoides 基因组和来自十二种组织的转录组显示，部分基因家族扩张，基因组也经历广泛重排。这些结果记录了所研究动物的基因组变化，并不把头足类的新性状归结为单一机制。
steps.annotation: Comparative association is not a single-gene cause of arms, suckers or neural complexity; whole-genome duplication was not supported.

steps.title: Two isolated sclerite types support a testable Micrina model
steps.titleZh: 两类孤立骨片支持可检验的 Micrina 复原
steps.text: Micrina mitral and sellate sclerites have complementary shapes and muscle scars. Researchers use them to reconstruct a sessile animal with two valves, but no fossil preserves the proposed valves joined together; the assembly remains a model, not a directly observed body.
steps.textZh: Micrina 的 mitral 与 sellate 两类骨片形状互补，并保存肌痕。研究者据此复原出一种固着、具有两片壳瓣的动物；但没有化石直接保存相连的两片壳瓣，因此整体结构仍是模型，而非直接观察到的完整身体。
steps.annotation: Articulation and valve homology are reconstructions, not a preserved whole organism or settled stem topology.

steps.title: Kutorgina preserves soft anatomy within paired valves
steps.titleZh: 顾脱贝在成对壳瓣间保存软组织
steps.text: Kutorgina chengjiangensis preserves an early spirolophe lophophore, digestive tract and pedicle together with its paired valves. The lophophore is the tentacle-bearing feeding organ; its form and the attachment stalk provide clues to function, but not an observation of the animal feeding or attaching.
steps.textZh: Kutorgina chengjiangensis 在成对壳瓣之间保存了早期螺旋腕冠、消化道和肉茎。腕冠是带有触手的摄食器官，腕冠形态与附着柄为功能解释提供线索，但没有直接记录动物如何摄食或附着。
steps.annotation: Direct anatomy informs comparison but does not make Kutorgina the ancestor of living rhynchonelliformeans.

steps.title: Three data layers separate shared and lineage-specific shell proteins
steps.titleZh: 三层数据区分共用与支系特异的壳蛋白
steps.text: The Lingula genome, RNA-expression profiles across developmental stages and a shell proteome—the proteins detected in shell material—can be compared as separate data layers. Together they distinguish shared components from proteins associated with phosphate shells in particular lineages; one living brachiopod does not represent every fossil shell.
steps.textZh: Lingula 基因组、不同发育阶段的 RNA 表达谱，以及壳体蛋白质组——在壳体材料中检测到的蛋白质——可作为三层数据分别比较。它们帮助区分共用成分与特定支系磷酸盐壳相关蛋白；一种现生腕足动物并不代表所有化石壳体。
steps.annotation: Shared genes do not imply shell identity, vertebrate bone homology or morphological stasis through the fossil record.

steps.title: Yuganotheca combines valves, tube and lophophore
steps.titleZh: Yuganotheca 将壳瓣、管体与腕冠组合在一起
steps.text: Yuganotheca preserves paired agglutinated valves, a horseshoe-shaped lophophore, a two-part tube and a long pedicle. Agglutinated valves are assembled from bound particles. The combination resists a simple ladder of body plans: several structures must be compared together, and no one feature alone establishes direct ancestry.
steps.textZh: Yuganotheca 保存成对的黏结颗粒壳瓣、马蹄形腕冠、由两部分构成的管体和长肉茎。黏结颗粒壳瓣由胶结在一起的颗粒构成。这种结构组合不支持把体制排成简单阶梯；需要综合比较多项结构，单一特征也不能证明直接祖先关系。
steps.annotation: COL26.8 routes 159,801 accepted living names here; that naming coverage cannot resolve this fossil mosaic or turn thirteen dossiers into an ancestor series.

title: Trilobites and chelicerates: evidence, models and disputed relationships
titleZh: 三叶虫与螯肢动物：解剖证据、模型与谱系争议
dek: Across trilobites, horseshoe crabs, scorpions and other fossils, each study asks a different question. Read anatomy and reconstructed family trees separately; the sequence is not an ancestor ladder.
dekZh: 三叶虫、鲎、蝎子和其他化石研究各自提出不同问题。阅读时应把解剖观察与重建的亲缘树分开；这些案例并不构成一条祖先阶梯。

steps.title: A model tests the trilobite’s abrupt fossil appearance
steps.text: Parsimony and Bayesian tree analyses of early artiopodans—arthropods related to trilobites—place the inferred trilobite origin shortly before the oldest widespread trilobite body fossils. Tree shape, clock priors, character coding and the uneven survival of fossils all affect that interval. A modelled origin is not itself a fossil occurrence or a known ancestor.
steps.titleZh: 模型检验三叶虫化石的突然出现
steps.textZh: 对早期阿蒂奥足类——与三叶虫相关的一支节肢动物——进行简约法和贝叶斯树分析后，模型把推定的三叶虫起源放在最早一批广泛出现的三叶虫身体化石之前不久。树形、分子钟先验、性状编码和化石保存不均都会影响这个时间区间。模型中的起源不是一件化石，也不是已知祖先。
steps.annotation: Tree shape, clock priors, character coding and survivorship bias condition the result; a modelled origin is not a fossil occurrence or a direct ancestor.

steps.title: Ash preserves a view beneath the trilobite
steps.text: X-ray microtomography reveals the underside of articulated trilobites preserved in ash. The scans show antennae, four pairs of head limbs behind the antennae, a labrum, a slit-like mouth and digestive tissues. This rare local window informs anatomical comparisons; it does not establish feeding behavior or anatomy for every trilobite.
steps.titleZh: 火山灰保存了三叶虫腹面的细节
steps.textZh: 对火山灰中关节连接的三叶虫进行 X 射线显微断层成像，可以看到身体腹面。图像显示触角、触角后方四对头部附肢、上唇、狭缝状口部和消化组织。这是局部且少见的保存窗口，可用于解剖比较，却不能代表所有三叶虫的行为或解剖。
steps.annotation: The inferred feeding apparatus and homologies compare a rare local preservational window; they do not establish behaviour, ancestry or anatomy for every trilobite.

steps.title: Does a limb branch preserve a gill?
steps.text: Triarthrus filaments have a narrow center with inflated margins, while Olenoides preserves part of a body-wall attachment. Those structures can be compared with flattened branches used for respiration in other animals. Gill function, blood flow and limb homology remain interpretations from two taxa, not direct measurements of gas exchange.
steps.titleZh: 附肢分支是否保存了鳃？
steps.textZh: Triarthrus 的丝状结构中部较窄、边缘膨大；Olenoides 则保存了部分体壁附着结构。研究者把它们与其他动物用于呼吸的扁平分支作比较。鳃功能、血淋巴（节肢动物体内的体液）流动和附肢分支的同源关系，仍是根据两个类群形态提出的解释，并非气体交换的直接测量。
steps.annotation: Gill function, haemolymph flow and limb-branch homology are functional interpretations from morphology across two taxa and times, not measured gas exchange.

steps.title: One gut preserves one last meal
steps.text: Synchrotron microtomography maps ostracod shells, hyolith material and stylophoran plates through inventory specimen 8 at 11.35-micrometre voxel size. The shelly contents suggest rapid, broad feeding and a neutral-to-alkaline gut, but both are inferences from one preserved meal. Soft foods and variation among individuals are absent from this sample.
steps.titleZh: 一份肠内容只记录一次进食
steps.textZh: 同步辐射显微断层成像显示了编目标本 8 中的介形类壳、软舌螺材料和柱头类板片，图像体素（组成三维图像的体积像素）尺寸为 11.35 微米。壳质内容提示快速而广泛的摄食，以及中性至碱性的肠道环境；两者都是从一份保存下来的餐食推断而来。软质食物和个体间差异没有进入这个样本。
steps.annotation: Rapid indiscriminate feeding and a neutral-to-alkaline gut are inferences from one biased shelly meal; soft food and population variation are not preserved.

steps.title: Adult agnostids test the trilobite relationship
steps.text: Adult Peronopsis and Ptychagnostus preserve two-branched limbs and anatomy used in enrolment. An explicit character matrix recovers them near polymeroid trilobites, but that result depends on sampled taxa and characters. Crustacean-like limb form and inferred life habit can arise through convergence and remain open to interpretation.
steps.titleZh: 成体小圆虫类检验三叶虫亲缘
steps.textZh: Peronopsis 和 Ptychagnostus 成体保存了双分支附肢，以及被用于解释身体卷曲的解剖特征。性状矩阵把它们恢复在聚合三叶虫附近，但结果取决于所采样的类群和性状。类似甲壳类的附肢形态与推断生活方式都可能由趋同产生，仍需解释。
steps.annotation: The recovered sister relationship to polymeroid trilobites depends on sampled characters and taxa; crustacean-like limbs and life habit remain homoplastic or ecological interpretations.

steps.title: Urokodia links different appendage forms
steps.text: Three-dimensional reconstructions of Urokodia show short, pincer-like great appendages, overlapping exite flaps and a seven-segmented head. The proposed homologies and its placement high on the chelicerate stem depend on how the fossil is reconstructed and scored. It is a possible morphological bridge, not a settled ancestor in a linear sequence.
steps.titleZh: Urokodia 的附肢形态仍需解释
steps.textZh: Urokodia 的三维重建显示短而钳状的大附肢、相互重叠的外肢片，以及由七个体节组成的头部。提出的同源关系及其位于螯肢动物干群较高位置的结论，都取决于化石如何重建和评分。它可能提供形态比较的桥梁，但不是线性祖先序列中的确定一环。
steps.annotation: Appendage homology and earliest-branching upper stem placement come from reconstruction and phylogenetic scoring and can change with competing character interpretations.

steps.title: Chelicerae enter the Cambrian fossil record
steps.text: The Chengjiang specimen KUMIP 314091a,b preserves large chelicerae, five limb pairs behind them on the prosoma, and lamella-bearing appendages on the rear body. These features support its identification and comparisons with other Cambrian arthropods. A predatory role and a bridging position between habeliids and synziphosurines are interpretations drawn from one specimen and a phylogenetic matrix.
steps.titleZh: 螯肢进入寒武纪化石记录
steps.textZh: 澄江标本 KUMIP 314091a,b 保存了大型螯肢、头胸部（prosoma）上位于螯肢之后的五对附肢，以及身体后部带有片层的附肢。这些特征支持标本鉴定，并可与其他寒武纪节肢动物比较。捕食角色及其位于哈贝利类和剑尾类干群之间的桥接位置，是根据单件标本和系统发育矩阵提出的解释。
steps.annotation: Predatory ecology and a bridge between habeliids and synziphosurines are functional and topology results from one specimen and a scored matrix.

steps.title: Nerves and limbs give competing signals
steps.text: MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093 preserve optic nerves, a possible compact head nerve center called a synganglion, and a segmented ventral nerve cord. The front of the fossils is incomplete, and nervous-system characters do not align simply with appendage characters. Several placements and mosaic-evolution scenarios therefore remain possible.
steps.titleZh: 神经与附肢性状给出不同信号
steps.textZh: MCZ 1811 和 USNM 305093 保存了视神经、可能的紧凑头部神经中枢（synganglion）以及分节的腹神经索。化石前端不完整；神经系统性状与附肢性状也不能简单地排列在同一模式中。因此，仍有多个系统位置和镶嵌演化情景可以解释。
steps.annotation: Incomplete anterior preservation and conflict between nervous-system and appendage characters permit competing placements and mosaic-evolution scenarios.

steps.title: A giant claw does not measure the whole animal
steps.text: A free cheliceral ramus with associated cuticle directly documents a giant pterygotid claw from the Early Devonian Willwerath sample. The often-cited body length of about 2.5 metres assumes that the claw-to-body proportions resembled those of comparable animals and that positive allometry was limited. It is an estimate from one appendage, not a measurement of a complete skeleton.
steps.titleZh: 一只巨爪不能直接量出全身长度
steps.textZh: 早泥盆世 Willwerath 样本中，一段游离的螯肢分支及其相关表皮，直接记录了一只巨大的翼肢鲎类螯爪。常被引用的约 2.5 米体长估计，假定该爪与身体的比例接近可比较动物，并假定附肢相对体长的正异速增长影响有限。它是依据一件附肢作出的估算，不是完整骨架的测量值。
steps.annotation: The approximately 2.5-metre body length assumes comparable chelicera-to-body proportions and limited positive allometry; it is not a complete skeleton measurement.

steps.title: Xiphosuran relationships enter an expanded matrix
steps.text: The analysis samples fossil and living horseshoe crabs, or xiphosurans, and rescored other living and fossil chelicerates in an expanded character matrix. It challenges the traditional grouping of synziphosurines and revises relationships within Xiphosura. Those tree results remain sensitive to missing anatomy, coding choices and which taxa are included.
steps.titleZh: 扩展矩阵检验剑尾类亲缘
steps.textZh: 该分析同时采样化石和现生鲎类（剑尾类），并用扩展的性状矩阵重新编码其他现生与化石螯肢动物。结果质疑了传统剑尾类干群组合，并修订了剑尾类内部关系。缺失解剖、性状编码和纳入哪些类群，都会影响这些树形结果。
steps.annotation: Polyphyly of traditional synziphosurines and internal Xiphosura relationships are topology results sensitive to coding, missing anatomy and taxon sampling.

steps.title: Internal anatomy does not settle habitat
steps.text: Scorpion holotype UWGM 2162 and paratype UWGM 2163 preserve a scorpion body plan and internal structures compared with respiratory and circulatory anatomy. The proposed homology with book lungs and the implications for life on land are interpretations. Nearshore deposits, transport and incomplete respiratory structures do not establish where the animal lived.
steps.titleZh: 内部解剖不能单独确定栖地
steps.textZh: 蝎子的正模 UWGM 2162 和副模 UWGM 2163 保存了蝎形身体结构及内部构造，研究者将它们与呼吸和循环解剖作比较。把这些结构同源于书肺、并据此讨论陆地生活，是解释而非直接观察。近岸沉积、搬运过程以及不完整的呼吸结构，不能确定动物生前住在哪里。
steps.annotation: Book-lung homology and terrestrial physiology are interpretations; nearshore strata, transport and incomplete respiratory structures do not prove habitat.

steps.title: Genomes have not fixed one arachnid root
steps.text: Large datasets of living species and subsets of slowly evolving genes produce competing trees: some recover Arachnida as a group, while others place horseshoe crabs among land-living chelicerates. Gene choice, uneven sequence composition, species sampling, morphology and model fit can change the result. The root and the number or timing of transitions onto land remain model-dependent.
steps.titleZh: 基因组尚未确定唯一的蛛形类根部
steps.textZh: 现生物种的大型数据集和缓慢演化基因的子集会得到彼此竞争的树：有些分析恢复蛛形纲为单系群，另一些则把鲎放在陆生螯肢动物之中。基因选择、序列组成不均、物种取样、形态信息和模型拟合都可能改变结果。因此，螯肢动物根部位置，以及向陆地转变的次数和时间，仍取决于模型。
steps.annotation: Gene choice, compositional heterogeneity, taxon sampling, morphology and model fit change the root; terrestrialization count and timing therefore remain topology-dependent. COL26.8 routes 104,126 strictly accepted species names through exact Chelicerata and Trilobita roots; that is nomenclatural coverage, not 104,126 mature dossiers or agreement among fossil, morphology and genomic models.

title: Thirteen dossiers from Cambrian mandibles to insect genomes
titleZh: 从寒武纪颚到昆虫基因组的十三个证据档案
dek: Follow thirteen fossil, phylogenomic, developmental, and dating studies without turning Pancrustacea, terrestrialization, or flight into one ancestor ladder.

steps.title: Two Tokummia specimens carry matrix characters
steps.titleZh: 两件 Tokummia 标本提供矩阵性状
steps.text: Holotype ROM 63823 and paratype ROM 63824 preserve appendage combinations scored in the published character matrix. Their placement is a phylogenetic result: neither specimen shows Tokummia to be a direct ancestor or a crown crustacean, insect, or myriapod.
steps.textZh: 正模 ROM 63823 和副模 ROM 63824 保存了发表矩阵中编码的附肢组合。其归属是系统发育结果；这些标本并不能证明 Tokummia 是直系祖先，也不能将它确定为冠群甲壳类、昆虫或多足类。
steps.annotation: Stem-mandibulate placement is a matrix result; Tokummia is neither a demonstrated direct ancestor nor a crown crustacean, insect or myriapod.

steps.title: A larger Waptia sample reveals more mandibles
steps.titleZh: 更大的 Waptia 样本显示更多颚部结构
steps.text: ROMIP 56432 illustrates mandibles and maxillules; ROMIP 64294 preserves disarticulated, opposing mandibles within a larger specimen series. Those structures inform anatomical and phylogenetic comparisons, but active swimming predation is an interpretation, not stomach contents or directly observed behavior.
steps.textZh: ROMIP 56432 展示了大颚和小颚；ROMIP 64294 在更大的标本系列中保存了分离的、彼此相对的大颚。这些结构有助于解剖和系统发育比较，但主动游泳捕食属于解释，并非胃内容物或直接观察到的行为。
steps.annotation: Pancrustacean placement and active swimming predation are topology and functional interpretations, not stomach contents, observed behaviour or a direct ancestor claim.

steps.title: Phosphatization preserves Yicaris growth stages
steps.titleZh: 磷酸盐化保存 Yicaris 的成长阶段
steps.text: The Yicaris topotype series includes several developmental stages. Phosphatized soft-part anatomy supports reconstruction of one stage with eight thoracic segments (thoracomeres). This sample shows growth variation, but does not fix the crown crustacean origin or settle whether similar appendages are homologous epipodites.
steps.textZh: Yicaris 的模式产地标本系列包含多个发育阶段。磷酸盐化保存的软组织解剖支持将其中一个阶段复原为具有八个胸节（thoracomeres）。这组材料显示成长差异，但不能确定冠群甲壳类的起源，也不能裁定相似附肢是否同源于上肢叶。
steps.annotation: Eucrustacean crown placement and epipodite homology depend on character interpretation and must not be converted into an exact crown-origin date.

steps.title: Nine transcriptomes test an undersampled branch
steps.titleZh: 九套转录组检验取样不足的分支
steps.text: Nine new 454 transcriptomes were combined with morphology, fossils, expressed sequence tags, genomes, mitochondrial proteins, and ribosomal data. Deep placements, including ostracod monophyly, change with fast-evolving genes, outgroups, and data partitions; the resulting branches are inferred relationships, not fossils.
steps.textZh: 九套新生成的 454 转录组与形态、化石、表达序列标签、基因组、线粒体蛋白和核糖体数据合并分析。包括介形类单系性在内的深层位置会随快速演化基因、外群和数据分区而变化；树枝表示推断的关系，不是化石本身。
steps.annotation: Ostracod monophyly and several deep nodes change when fast genes, distant outgroups or data partitions change; no displayed branch is a fossil observation.

steps.title: Remipedes repeatedly group with hexapods
steps.titleZh: 多次分析将桨足纲与六足动物聚为姐妹群
steps.text: With expanded remipede sampling, analyses repeatedly recover Remipedia and Hexapoda as sister groups while supporting several major pancrustacean clades. Other deep relationships remain sensitive to sampling and method, so this is a tested tree hypothesis rather than a settled ancestor ladder.
steps.textZh: 扩大桨足纲取样后，多个分析反复恢复桨足纲与六足动物为姐妹群，同时支持若干主要泛甲壳类支系。其他深层关系仍受取样和方法影响，因此这是一项经过检验的树假说，而非定论的祖先阶梯。
steps.annotation: Copepod, cephalocarid and other deep positions remain method- and sampling-sensitive, so the tree is a tested hypothesis rather than a fixed ancestor ladder.

steps.title: Seven added taxa reshape the pancrustacean matrix
steps.titleZh: 新增七个类群改变泛甲壳类矩阵
steps.text: The final matrix samples 105 taxa—90 transcriptomes, 15 genomes, and 576 protein-coding genes—and is compared with a 98-taxon matrix assembled through the same pipeline. Recovered clades vary with dataset and model; divergence dates are clock estimates informed by vetted calibrations, not observed fossil events.
steps.textZh: 最终矩阵包含 105 个类群、90 套转录组、15 个基因组和 576 个蛋白编码基因，并与通过相同流程构建的 98 类群矩阵比较。恢复出的支系会随数据集和模型而变；分化年代是由筛选过的校准点约束的分子钟估计，不是直接观察到的化石事件。
steps.annotation: Rejected and recovered clades differ among sampled matrices and models; divergence estimates use thirteen vetted calibrations but remain clock outputs.

steps.title: A Devonian springtail-like fossil preserves a furcula
steps.titleZh: 泥盆纪弹尾类样化石保存叉器
steps.text: The Rhyniella sample includes four head capsules and about ten later body specimens. It contains the first reported intact abdomen and a furcula, a forked springing structure comparable to that of living springtails. This occurrence supports collembolan affinity but does not date the global origin of hexapods or their move onto land.
steps.textZh: Rhyniella 样本包括四个头壳和约十件较晚报道的身体标本，其中有首件报道的完整腹部及一枚叉器——与现生弹尾类相似的分叉弹跳结构。这条出现记录支持其与弹尾类的亲缘，但不能确定六足动物的全球起源或登陆时间。
steps.annotation: This sampled occurrence supports collembolan affinity but does not by itself date hexapod terrestrialization, global origin or ecological dominance.

steps.title: One head fragment yields competing identities
steps.titleZh: 一块头骨碎片引出相互冲突的归属
steps.text: NHMUK PI IN 38234 is an isolated head fragment. A 2004 study interpreted its mandibles as dicondylic—having two jaw hinges—and possibly pterygote-like; a 2017 three-dimensional reanalysis found a better fit with a myriapod, perhaps a scutigeromorph centipede. The conflicting readings leave insect and flight calibrations uncertain.
steps.textZh: NHMUK PI IN 38234 是一块孤立头骨碎片。2004 年研究把其大颚解释为双髁式（具有两个关节接点），并认为可能类似有翅昆虫；2017 年三维重分析则认为更符合多足类，可能是蚰蜒类。相互冲突的解读使昆虫和飞行起源校准仍不确定。
steps.annotation: Three-dimensional reanalysis in 2017 found the structures more compatible with a myriapod, possibly a scutigeromorph centipede; insect and flight calibrations are therefore contested.

steps.title: Genes and fossils model routes onto land
steps.titleZh: 基因与化石模型检验登陆路径
steps.text: The core dataset combines 57 taxa and 246 genes; fossil calibrations and a 30-species panarthropod subset test alternative trees. The favored marine route and its dates depend on topology, calibrations, and ancestral-state coding. They are model outputs, not observed migrations.
steps.textZh: 核心数据集结合 57 个类群和 246 个基因；化石校准及一个含 30 个物种的泛节肢动物子集用于检验不同树形。较受支持的海洋路径及其年代取决于拓扑、校准和祖先状态编码，是模型输出，不是实际观察到的迁移。
steps.annotation: A favoured marine route and inferred dates are model outputs conditioned on topology, calibrations and ancestral-state coding, not observed migrations.

steps.title: One Carboniferous wing fragment records venation
steps.titleZh: 一块石炭纪翅片记录翅脉
steps.text: An approximately 10 mm crushed forewing from lowermost Namurian strata preserves cross-veins and branches of ScP, R, and other main veins. Archaeorthopteran affinity is inferred from incomplete venation; one fragment cannot date powered flight or the first global occurrence of Pterygota.
steps.textZh: 一块约 10 毫米、受压扁的前翅来自 Namurian 最下部地层，保存有横脉及 ScP、R 等主脉分支。其 Archaeorthoptera 亲缘依据不完整翅脉推断；单块翅片不能确定动力飞行的起源或有翅昆虫的全球首现时间。
steps.annotation: Archaeorthopteran affinity follows incomplete venation, and one fragment cannot date the acquisition of powered flight or the global Pterygota first appearance.

steps.title: Gene perturbations test a wing-homology model
steps.titleZh: 基因扰动检验翅同源模型
steps.text: CRISPR perturbations and expression domains in Parhyale are compared with proximal leg segments, body-wall structures, and wings in crickets and other insects. These developmental correspondences test a homology model; they do not identify the first insect wing or a unique fossil precursor.
steps.textZh: 研究将 Parhyale 的 CRISPR 基因扰动与表达区域，同蟋蟀及其他昆虫的近端足节、体壁结构和翅进行比较。这些发育对应关系用于检验同源模型，但不能指出最早的昆虫翅或唯一的化石祖先。
steps.annotation: Developmental correspondence supports a homology model but does not preserve the first wing, its ecology or one uniquely identified fossil precursor.

steps.title: A 1,478-gene matrix estimates insect branching times
steps.titleZh: 1,478 基因矩阵估计昆虫分支年代
steps.text: The study samples 144 species and 1,478 protein-coding genes, including archived transcriptomes from BioProject PRJNA183205. Tree topology and node ages depend on taxon sampling, orthology, sequence models, fossil assignments, and clock priors; the ages are estimates, not observed fossil first appearances.
steps.textZh: 该研究取样 144 个物种和 1,478 个蛋白编码基因，并纳入 BioProject PRJNA183205 存档的转录组。系统树拓扑与节点年代取决于类群取样、直系同源基因、序列模型、化石归属及分子钟先验；年代是估计值，不是观察到的化石首现。
steps.annotation: Topology and node ages depend on sampling, orthology, sequence models, fossil assignments and clock priors; they are not observed fossil first appearances.

steps.title: Five Pennsylvanian fossils broaden the sample
steps.titleZh: 五件宾夕法尼亚世化石扩展样本
steps.text: The described Pennsylvanian sample includes a stem coleopterid, a holometabolous larva, a stem hymenopterid, an early hemipteran, and an early psocodean. These fossils broaden the record but do not show synchronous origins, exact first appearances of crown orders, or one climatic cause for later diversification.
steps.textZh: 所描述的宾夕法尼亚世样本包括一件甲虫类干群化石、一只完全变态幼虫、一件膜翅类干群化石、早期半翅类和早期啮虫类。它们扩展了化石记录，但不证明各类群同步起源、冠群目级类群的精确首现，或后续多样化由单一气候原因造成。
steps.annotation: The specimens do not demonstrate synchronous origins, exact crown-order first appearances or a single climatic cause for later diversification. COL26.8 routes 1,049,133 accepted living species names through crustaceans-insects; this is nomenclatural coverage, not 1,049,133 evidence dossiers or a phylogenomic consensus.

dekZh: 沿着十三项化石、系统基因组、发育与年代研究展开阅读，不要把泛甲壳类、登陆或飞行串成单一祖先阶梯。

title: Three tested routes to living amphibians
titleZh: 通向现生两栖类的三条检验路线
dek: These matrix studies test temnospondyl, lepospondyl, and stereospondyl-linked routes to living amphibians. Their outcomes depend on sampled taxa and analytical choices; none alone establishes a settled sequence of direct ancestors.
summaryZh: 这些矩阵研究检验了离片椎类、细螈类以及与立体椎类相连的现生两栖类起源路线。结果取决于纳入的分类单元和分析选择；任何一项都不能单独确立直接祖先序列。

steps.title: Dissorophoids near the living branch
steps.text: In Schoch's dissorophoid matrix, sampled living amphibians fall within Amphibamiformes near Gerobatrachus. Support is low, and other matrices recover alternatives, so the result remains a tested topology rather than a settled ancestor tree.
steps.titleZh: 离片椎类靠近现生支系
steps.textZh: 在 Schoch 的离片椎类矩阵中，所采样的现生两栖类落在 Amphibamiformes 内，靠近 Gerobatrachus。支持度较低，其他矩阵也得到不同结果；因此这是一种经过检验的系统位置，而非确定的祖先树。
steps.annotation: This is a sampled morphology topology, not an observed ancestor or consensus origin.

steps.title: A revised matrix favors a lepospondyl route
steps.text: Marjanović and Laurin corrected and expanded their matrix. Under their analyses, the lepospondyl route became the shorter tree, but bootstrap support was generally low and other matrices disagreed.
steps.titleZh: 修订矩阵使细螈类路线更短
steps.textZh: Marjanović 与 Laurin 修订并扩充了矩阵。在他们的分析中，细螈类路线对应较短的树；但自展支持度普遍较低，其他矩阵也不一致。
steps.annotation: Parsimony step difference is analysis-specific and is not translated into probability or consensus.

steps.title: Broader caecilian sampling changes one route
steps.text: One analysis of Chinlestegophis linked caecilians with stereospondyls. With broader sampling that includes Funcusvermis, another analysis instead recovered a dissorophoid stem for caecilians. The contrast shows how added fossils and matrix choices can change the tested relationship.
steps.titleZh: 扩展蚓螈取样改变一条路线
steps.textZh: 一项分析依据 Chinlestegophis 将蚓螈与立体椎类联系起来。另一项纳入更多材料、包括 Funcusvermis 的分析，则恢复了蚓螈的离片椎类干群路线。这一差异说明新增化石和矩阵选择会改变被检验的亲缘关系。
steps.annotation: The conflict is retained as two published results rather than resolved editorially.

dekZh: 这些矩阵研究检验了通向现生两栖动物的不同路径假说，分别涉及迷齿类、离片椎类和与立体椎类相关的路径。研究结果取决于取样类群及分析选择；没有哪项研究单独确立了已解决的直接祖先序列。

title: From echinoderm fragments to crown time
titleZh: 从棘皮动物骨片到冠群年代
dek: Follow five separate records, from Cambrian skeletal mesh to articulated fossils, class-level appearances and clock-based crown ages.
dekZh: 沿着五类独立记录前进：从寒武纪骨骼网状结构，到关节相连的化石、各纲的化石出现，以及分子钟估计的冠群年代。

steps.title: What an isolated stereom fragment can show
steps.text: Cambrian Stage 3 ossicles preserve stereom, the porous calcitic mesh that makes up an echinoderm skeleton. But an isolated ossicle cannot reveal a complete body plan, and it does not date the phylum’s origin.
steps.titleZh: 孤立的立体网骨片能说明什么
steps.textZh: 寒武纪第三期的骨片保存了立体网结构——构成棘皮动物骨骼的多孔方解石网。但孤立骨片不能揭示完整的身体结构，也不能给棘皮动物门的起源定年。
steps.annotation: The source-reported numerical calibration is approximate and older than the atlas's current chart.

steps.title: Why Yanjiahella remains a candidate
steps.text: One analysis placed Yanjiahella on the echinoderm stem, but a published reanalysis found neither stereom nor an unambiguous shared derived trait, or synapomorphy, linking it to echinoderms. The proposed Fortunian occurrence therefore remains contested; it cannot set a secure first appearance.
steps.titleZh: 为什么 Yanjiahella 仍只是候选者
steps.textZh: 一项分析把 Yanjiahella 放在棘皮动物干群；后续重分析却没有发现立体网结构，也没有发现明确连接棘皮动物的共有衍征。因此，它在幸运期的可能出现仍有争议，不能据此确定可靠的最早记录。
steps.annotation: Competing matrices are evidence of disagreement, not permission to select a convenient endpoint.

steps.title: Articulated bodies provide a firmer comparison
steps.text: By about 510 Ma, articulated echinoderm fossils—bodies whose parts remain connected—show at least four markedly different body plans. These are stronger body-level evidence than loose stereom fragments, but they show diversification already under way, not the phylum’s exact first appearance.
steps.titleZh: 关节相连的身体提供更直接的比较
steps.textZh: 到约 5.1 亿年前，身体部位仍相连的棘皮动物化石已显示至少四种明显不同的体制。与零散立体网骨片相比，这些化石提供了更完整的身体证据；它们表明多样化已经展开，却不能确定棘皮动物门最初出现的确切时刻。
steps.annotation: A robust sampled fauna is still not the first evolutionary instant of Echinodermata.

steps.title: Each echinoderm class has its own fossil record
steps.text: The unproblematic crinoid record begins in the middle Tremadocian, whereas the oldest articulated holothurian in this dossier is late Darriwilian. Those class-level bounds come from different specimens and strata; neither one stands in for the whole phylum.
steps.titleZh: 每个棘皮动物纲都有自己的化石记录
steps.textZh: 可靠的海百合纲化石记录始于特里马道克期中期；本档案所用最早的关节相连海参纲化石则来自达瑞威尔期晚期。两个纲的时间界限依据不同标本与地层，任何一项都不能代替整个棘皮动物门的记录。
steps.annotation: Different preservation histories prevent one class record from standing in for every echinoderm class.

steps.title: Separate fossil relatives from crown-age models
steps.text: Darriwilian bothriocidaroid plates anchor total-group Echinoidea: the living crown and its extinct stem relatives. Phylogenomic clock analyses place the crown near the Carboniferous–Permian transition, but that divergence time is model-dependent. A fossil occurrence and an inferred split answer different questions.
steps.titleZh: 把化石亲缘类群与冠群年代模型分开
steps.textZh: 达瑞威尔期的 bothriocidaroid 盘片为海胆纲总群提供化石界限；总群包括现生冠群及其已灭绝的干群亲缘类群。系统基因组分子钟把冠群年代估在石炭纪—二叠纪交界附近，但这个分化时间依赖模型。化石出现和推断的分支分化回答的是不同问题。
steps.annotation: A fossil occurrence and a modelled divergence answer different questions and remain separate in the atlas.

title: How geologic evidence dates change through deep time
titleZh: 地质证据怎样为深时变化定年
dek: Trace nine cases from dated minerals and measured strata to biological interpretation, keeping each uncertainty attached to the evidence.

steps.title: Oxygenation has a bracket, not an instant
steps.titleZh: 氧化事件有年代范围，不是单一瞬间
steps.text: Dated igneous rocks and changes in sulfur-isotope signals bracket the onset of the Great Oxidation interval. Ocean basins followed different redox histories, so the evidence does not describe one simultaneous change in every sea.
steps.textZh: 有精确年代的火成岩与硫同位素信号变化，共同限定了大氧化事件开始的时间范围。不同海盆经历了不同的氧化还原过程，因此这些证据并不表示所有海洋在同一时刻发生变化。
steps.annotation: The bracket dates a proxy transition, not one global oxygen switch.

steps.title: Zircon places Avalon after the Gaskiers ice
steps.titleZh: 锆石把阿瓦隆化石群排在盖斯凯尔冰期之后
steps.text: Zircon ages place the Gaskiers glaciation before the younger Avalon fossil assemblages. The dates establish a sequence between ice and fossils; they do not directly date when animals first originated.
steps.textZh: 锆石年龄显示，盖斯凯尔冰期早于较年轻的阿瓦隆化石群。年代资料建立了冰期与化石群的先后顺序，却没有直接测出动物最初起源的时间。
steps.annotation: A regional measured succession is not a global FAD.

steps.title: Cambrian fossils show a pattern; models explain it
steps.titleZh: 寒武纪化石显示辐射，成因仍有不同解释
steps.text: Cambrian body fossils, trace fossils and growing disparity—the range of body forms represented—document a major radiation. Ecological and developmental models offer explanations, but remain competing syntheses of the fossil pattern.
steps.textZh: 寒武纪的实体化石、遗迹化石与不断扩大的形态差异——化石所代表的身体形式范围——共同显示了一次重要辐射。生态和发育模型都可解释这一模式，但它们仍是彼此竞争的综合解释。

steps.title: Ordovician diversification varied by region
steps.titleZh: 奥陶纪多样化在不同地区步调不一
steps.text: Species richness and ecological expansion increased at different rates among Ordovician regions and groups. The records describe several regional histories, not a single global moment when marine life changed everywhere at once.
steps.textZh: 奥陶纪不同地区与类群的物种丰富度及生态扩展速度并不相同。化石记录描绘的是多段区域历史，而不是全球海洋生物同时变化的一个时刻。

steps.title: Ash beds time the main Meishan pulse
steps.titleZh: 火山灰层为梅山主要灭绝脉冲定时
steps.text: Dated ash beds at the Meishan reference section constrain its principal extinction pulse to roughly sixty thousand years, with analytical uncertainty. This is a tightly bounded interval in one section, not a direct measure of the same duration at every site.
steps.textZh: 梅山标准剖面中有年代约束的火山灰层，将主要灭绝脉冲限定在约六万年内，同时保留测年误差。这是一个剖面中的窄时间范围，并非对所有地点相同持续时间的直接测量。
steps.annotation: A calibrated reference section is not every ecosystem worldwide.

steps.title: Recovery followed different paths
steps.titleZh: 生态恢复沿不同路线展开
steps.text: Triassic recovery varies among ecosystems, ecological guilds and regions. A review can organize these records into stages, but its synthesis is not one event measured at a single place and time.
steps.textZh: 三叠纪的恢复在不同生态系统、功能群与地区并不同步。综述可以把这些记录归纳为若干阶段，但这种综合不是在单一地点、单一时刻测得的一个事件。

steps.title: Impact and extinction coincide within dating precision
steps.titleZh: 撞击与灭绝在测年精度内同时发生
steps.text: Boundary geochemistry identifies impact ejecta, and radioisotopic ages compare the impact with the extinction interval. Within the published precision, the two are synchronous; that result does not by itself measure every ecological consequence.
steps.textZh: 界线地球化学识别出撞击喷出物，放射性同位素年龄则用于比较撞击与灭绝区间。按论文给出的精度，两者时间一致；这一结果本身并不测量所有生态后果。
steps.annotation: Synchrony at this resolution does not make every last fossil simultaneous.

steps.title: PETM warming appears across several proxies
steps.titleZh: 多个替代指标共同记录古新世—始新世极热事件
steps.text: Carbon-isotope, temperature and biotic records track the PETM perturbation. These proxies are indirect measures of past conditions, so estimates of its magnitude and duration remain sensitive to the proxy and age model used.
steps.textZh: 碳同位素、温度与生物记录共同追踪古新世—始新世极热事件的环境扰动。这些都是过去环境的间接指标，因此事件幅度与持续时间的估计仍受指标选择和年代模型影响。

steps.title: Megafaunal losses have regional histories
steps.titleZh: 巨型动物消失具有不同的区域历史
steps.text: Late-Quaternary megafaunal losses differ across continents. Comparative models test climate and human influence, but the records do not reveal one universal mechanism acting identically everywhere.
steps.textZh: 晚第四纪巨型动物的消失在不同大陆并不相同。比较模型检验气候与人类影响，但现有记录没有显示一个在所有地区都以相同方式起作用的普遍机制。

dekZh: 沿着九个案例，从矿物定年和地层测量追踪到生物学解释，并将每项不确定性与其证据一并呈现。
